She could tell that if those attacks made direct contact with her physical body, her shadow pathways would suffer severe elemental damage...
Yet, as she sprinted straight toward the searing laser beams, a bright playful grin broke across Tasmin’s face.
She looked down at her right gauntlet.
Wrapped around her right wrist was a sleek dark-purple gauntlet.
It was a custom masterpiece forged personally by Thora, the Master Smith, and inscribed with high-tier defensive runes by Rowenna, the Grand Runemaster.

chapters.title: Chapter 305: "Faithful" 1 v 1 [II / Bonus - ]
paragraphs: The gauntlet was specifically designed with a special rune function engineered to completely absorb, neutralize, and reflect opposite elemental affinities like Light and Holy magic.

If Tasmin simply raised her right hand right now, Thora’s gauntlet would absorb Celeste’s solar beams instantly, catch the priestess completely by surprise, create a massive open window, and allow Tasmin to end this duel in a single effortless execution strike.
...However, right as her fingers hovered over the gauntlet’s trigger—
THUMP!
A sudden deep realization echoed in Tasmin’s heart.
She remembered her private vow to her Lord.
She had promised herself that she would become strong enough to handle entire armies for her Lord with one hand, while holding her cute, beloved Lord in her other arm.
It was completely logical to use the gauntlet...
In fact, utilizing high-tier gadgets to defeat an opponent efficiently was standard.
THUMP!
’But...’ Tasmin thought, her grin turning intensely mischievous, ’...that won’t make me look cool!’
The entire purpose of this forward deployment was to put on a legendary, breathtaking show for her Lord and the global stream...
The other girls like Brida, Fenna, and Gunnhild as well as Hilda who had broken off to the side and was dealing with stuff were out there pulling off epic cinematic combat moves.
How on earth was Tasmin supposed to impress her Lord and capture the hearts of millions of fans if she just relied on a cheap defensive gadget to win her fight?!
’No way!’ Tasmin declared internally. ’I’m winning this with pure skill!’
SWISH! SWISH! THUMP!
Tasmin executed two impossibly fast razor-thin evasive sways.
The first two beams missed her torso by a hair’s breadth, slamming into the ground behind her and blasting massive ten-foot craters into the bedrock.
BOOM! BOOM!
As the third solar beam screamed toward her neck, Tasmin glanced down at the dirt.
Lying beside a shattered shield was a heavy steel broadsword dropped by a fallen knight.
Tasmin didn’t even hesitate. She kicked the hilt of the broadsword with the toe of her boot, sending the weapon flying into her waiting right hand.
CLANG!
Tasmin brought the stolen broadsword up in an angled parry stance, catching the third solar beam directly against the flat of the steel blade.
HISSSSSSS!

The searing light slammed into the steel, grinding against the blade with immense pressure as the force of the beam pinned Tasmin in place with her boots digging deep trenches into the soil as she held the blade steady against the burning beam.
Celeste Sunsword’s eyes lit up with sadistic delight. Seeing her target pinned down and unable to dodge...
"GWAHAHA! GOT YOU!" Celeste laughed maniacally, flicking her wrist to accelerate the remaining two solar beams. "PURGE IN HOLY LIGHT!"
FWOOSH! FWOOSH!
The two remaining solar beams curved through the air, striking Tasmin squarely in the chest and abdomen.
BOOM!
The superheated light penetrated completely through Tasmin’s torso, vaporizing her body in a blinding flare of white fire.
Celeste Sunsword stood on the grass with her rapier lowered and her chest heaving as a triumphant arrogant smirk spread across her face.
"Bullseye..." Celeste sneered arrogantly, wiping a drop of sweat from her forehead. "Told you that you would die by my hand, shadow-rat—"
"If that’s all you thought it would take to get rid of me..." a smooth and chillingly playful voice whispered directly into Celeste’s right ear. "...then you are severely mistaken."
Celeste’s heart completely stopped beating as her blood ran ice-cold!
She snapped her head around—
Standing directly behind her, completely uninjured, was Tasmin!

The physical body that Celeste had just "pierced" with her solar beams dissolved into a harmless cloud of dark dissipating shadow smoke... it had been a Tier 2 [Shadow Decoy] created the exact microsecond the parry had blinded Celeste’s vision!
Tasmin was holding the stolen broadsword in her right hand.
HUMMMMM!
A terrifying suffocating concentration of pitch-black magic wrapped around the steel blade, turning the stolen sword into a glowing weapon of pure death.
Tasmin raised the broadsword high over her head, her eyes glowing with execution intent.
Celeste Sunsword’s eyes dilated in horror, her throat choked up, and she couldn’t even form a shield spell in time.
"Ha—" Celeste gasped out, terror seizing her soul.
BOOOOOOOOOOM!
Before Tasmin’s sword could descend—
An apocalyptic lightning-fast strike shot down directly from the sky like a falling meteor, crashing straight into the narrow gap between Tasmin and Celeste!
KABAGHHH!
A massive twenty-foot crater erupted in the center of their confrontation.

A violent, crushing shockwave of golden light and shattered stone blasted outward in every direction, tearing up the grass, kicking up a blinding wall of white dust, and violently throwing the wounded soldiers in the background flat onto their backs.
SWISH.
Tasmin was forced to execute a rapid backward leap with her boots landing lightly on the edge of the crater as she let out a deep heavy breath.
CRACK!
The stolen broadsword in Tasmin’s right hand was completely decimated in half...
The top half of the blade shattered into molten metal fragments, and the remaining stub was burning with intense solar fire.
Tasmin let go of the burning hilt, letting the ruined weapon drop into the dirt.
The thick dark shadows wrapping around her right hand had taken the full force of the surprise aerial impact.
The shadowy aura was severely scorched, but thanks to her Level 30 passive skills and high vitality regeneration, the dark smoke healed and restored her wrist pathways instantly.
Tasmin narrowed her eyes, looking into the dust crater.
If she hadn’t instinctively coated her right hand in shadow magic right before the impact... that surprise aerial strike would have severed my wrist clean off!
Sitting in the center of the crater, hyperventilating in panic, was Celeste Sunsword.
She had been saved at the last second.
Embedded deep into the dirt directly in front of her knees was a massive eight-foot-long Greatsword of Holy Light, radiating a protective golden barrier around her trembling form.
FWOOSH!
High above the crater, standing atop a towering heap of shattered siege rocks fifty yards away, stood a second figure.
She was clad in identical white priestess robes, her face identical to Celeste’s... meaning she was the second twin Hero.
She raised her hand, and with a soft telepathic pull, the massive Greatsword of Holy Light flew out of the crater, soaring through the air and landing perfectly back into her gloved grip.
Tasmin stood on the edge of the crater, rolling her right wrist as she looked up at the twin on the rocks, letting out a soft amused chuckle.
"Well, well, well..." Tasmin joked smoothly. "Look who decided to join the party! And here I thought you sisters believed in a ’clean, faithful 1-v-1 duel’?"
Celeste Sunsword scrambled up from the dirt, grabbing her fallen rapier as her sister floated into the air.
Celeste wiped a trickle of sweat from her cheek, shooting Tasmin a defiant arrogant smirk.
"Heh!" Celeste sneered, trying to recover her lost dignity. "You really think I’m like those stupid manga villains who’ll tell my own twin sibling to withdraw just because of some silly pride—"
SWISH!
Before Celeste could even finish her sentence—
Tasmin completely vanished from sight!
In less than a hundredth of a second, Tasmin closed a fifty-yard gap at blinding speed.
[ACTIVE SKILL ACTIVATED: Phantom Leap / Blitz]
BAM!
Before Celeste or her twin could even raise their swords or react to the movement, Tasmin materialized directly in front of Celeste’s face.
Without drawing a weapon, Tasmin drove a brutal and heavily reinforced elbow straight into Celeste’s nose!
CRACK!
A sickening crunch of shattered bone echoed through the crater.

Celeste’s head was violently thrust backward at a terrifying angle as a fountain of crimson blood erupted from her broken nose, spraying across the dirt as her body was launched thirty feet backward, crashing hard against the rocks!
Tasmin landed lightly on her toes, her posture completely relaxed as she looked down at the bleeding, gasping priestess.
"I don’t really give a damn about all of that villain speech nonsense..." Tasmin spoke softly.
HUMMMMM!
[ACTIVE SKILL ACTIVATED: Shadow Strengthening]
Suddenly, thick pitch-black void shadows erupted directly from Tasmin’s crimson eyes!
The shadow aura around her physical form flared wildly, shaping into terrifying demonic wings behind her back, while a gorgeous devilishly wicked smile spread across her flawless face.
She looked like a supreme, unholy Shadow Empress who had descended onto the mortal world to claim souls.

Tasmin looked straight at the camera lens of a hovering streaming drone ten feet away, her crimson eyes burning with an intoxicating charm as she delivered her words to the five hundred million viewers watching across the globe.
"You see... our Lord Vespera told me that the rest of the Human world is watching us today."
Tasmin raised her hand, her twin weapons spinning hypnotically around her fingers, her smile turning completely irresistible.
"So keep making me look cool to both my Lord... and my fans, okay?"
BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!
A blinding superheated blast of pure light shot through the dust-choked air, missing the back of Tasmin’s neck by a mere fraction of an inch.

The concentrated beam of light slammed directly into the pile of fallen soldiers behind her, instantly incinerating the corpses into black ash and releasing a wave of dry suffocating heat that rippled across the entire crater!
High above the field, hovering against the gray clouds, the second twin sister... Hana had taken to the sky.
Her pristine white priestess robes billowed wildly in the wind with her white eyes burning with divine fury as she channeled her light magic into the heavens!
FWOOSH! FWOOSH! FWOOSH!
A terrifying rain of weapons constructed entirely from solid, superheated solar magic descended from the sky.

Dozens of glowing white spears, lances, and javelins rained down upon the earth, tearing through the air with deafening, whistling shrieks as they bombarded the ground around Tasmin in a continuous, explosive carpet-bombing.
BOOM! KABOOM! BOOM!
Plumes of earth, shattered bedrock, and golden fire erupted across the clearing!
Yet, through the chaotic storm of falling solar artillery, Tasmin’s crimson eyes remained completely and unyieldingly locked onto her primary target... Celeste Sunsword.
Celeste was hovering five feet off the grass, suspended inside a churning, miniature tornado of swirling white light.
Her face was pale, covered in dirt and sweat, as her broken bloody nose dripped crimson drops down her chin.
She was frantically backpedaling across the field, her eyes wide with a mixture of terror and rage as she kept her crystal rapier pointed straight at the approaching shadow mage.
"STAY BACK, YOU FILTHY SHADOW DEMON!" Celeste shrieked at the top of her lungs, spitting bloody saliva from her lips as she unleashed spell after spell. "DON’T YOU COME ANY CLOSER TO ME! GET AWAY!"
Tasmin sprinted effortlessly through the cratered terrain, her boots gliding across the soil like a hunting panther.
She tilted her head, her dark pigtails swaying behind her ears as a smooth mocking grin spread across her lips.

"My, my, Celeste..." Tasmin called out, her voice easily cutting through the thunderous explosions of light behind her. "Aren’t you supposed to be a divine High Priestess of Light from The Unmovable Wall? Are holy priestesses even allowed to curse and scream like hysterical street urchins? What would your devoted followers on the stream think if they heard you right now?"
"SHUT UP! SHUT YOUR FILTHY MOUTH!" Celeste screamed frantically with her noble composure completely shattered.
She thrust her crystal rapier forward in a wild uncontrolled sequence...
FWOOSH! FWOOSH! FWOOSH!
A dozen massive lances of pure light materialized around her floating form, shooting forward in a dense fan-shaped barrage designed to impale Tasmin’s limbs.
Tasmin’s hands blurred...
She unholstered her twin shortswords with her fingers locking tightly around the dark steel hilts while the Eclipse-Thread chains wrapped securely around her forearms.
CLANG! CRACK!
Instead of retreating into the shadows, Tasmin stepped directly into the path of the incoming solar lances.
She spun her right shortsword like a glowing dark-purple boomerang, launching the chained blade through the air.
The void-infused steel sliced cleanly through the first three light lances, bisecting the dense magic mid-air and detonating them into harmless sparks of white fire.
Celeste’s jaw dropped in shock.
"W-What?! That’s solid light magic! How are your daggers cutting through my spells?!"
"Did you forget who forged these blades, darling?" Tasmin chuckled, flicking her wrist to snap the chained shortsword back into her palm. "Our Master Smith doesn’t make toys!"
"I DON’T CARE! DIE!" Celeste shrieked with her fingers twitching violently as she summoned twenty more lances of light, filling the entire corridor between them with a solid wall of searing energy.
Seeing the impassable wall of superheated light rushing toward her, Tasmin didn’t stop.
Her crimson eyes glinted with sharp reckless genius.
STEP!
Tasmin launched herself into the air, driving the tip of her left shortsword directly into the center of the lead solar lance!
HISSSSSSS!

KABAGHHH!
A massive twenty-foot crater erupted in the center of their confrontation.

A violent, crushing shockwave of golden light and shattered stone blasted outward in every direction, tearing up the grass, kicking up a blinding wall of white dust, and violently throwing the wounded soldiers in the background flat onto their backs.
SWISH.
Tasmin was forced to execute a rapid backward leap with her boots landing lightly on the edge of the crater as she let out a deep heavy breath.
CRACK!
The stolen broadsword in Tasmin’s right hand was completely decimated in half...
The top half of the blade shattered into molten metal fragments, and the remaining stub was burning with intense solar fire.
Tasmin let go of the burning hilt, letting the ruined weapon drop into the dirt.
The thick dark shadows wrapping around her right hand had taken the full force of the surprise aerial impact.
The shadowy aura was severely scorched, but thanks to her Level 30 passive skills and high vitality regeneration, the dark smoke healed and restored her wrist pathways instantly.
Tasmin narrowed her eyes, looking into the dust crater.
If she hadn’t instinctively coated her right hand in shadow magic right before the impact... that surprise aerial strike would have severed my wrist clean off!
Sitting in the center of the crater, hyperventilating in panic, was Celeste Sunsword.
She had been saved at the last second.
Embedded deep into the dirt directly in front of her knees was a massive eight-foot-long Greatsword of Holy Light, radiating a protective golden barrier around her trembling form.
FWOOSH!
High above the crater, standing atop a towering heap of shattered siege rocks fifty yards away, stood a second figure.
She was clad in identical white priestess robes, her face identical to Celeste’s... meaning she was the second twin Hero.
She raised her hand, and with a soft telepathic pull, the massive Greatsword of Holy Light flew out of the crater, soaring through the air and landing perfectly back into her gloved grip.
Tasmin stood on the edge of the crater, rolling her right wrist as she looked up at the twin on the rocks, letting out a soft amused chuckle.
"Well, well, well..." Tasmin joked smoothly.
"Look who decided to join the party!
And here I thought you sisters believed in a ’clean, faithful 1-v-1 duel’?"
Celeste Sunsword scrambled up from the dirt, grabbing her fallen rapier as her sister floated into the air.
Celeste wiped a trickle of sweat from her cheek, shooting Tasmin a defiant arrogant smirk.
"Heh!" Celeste sneered, trying to recover her lost dignity.
"You really think I’m like those stupid manga villains who’ll tell my own twin sibling to withdraw just because of some silly pride—"
SWISH!
Before Celeste could even finish her sentence—
Tasmin completely vanished from sight!
In less than a hundredth of a second, Tasmin closed a fifty-yard gap at blinding speed.
[ACTIVE SKILL ACTIVATED: Phantom Leap / Blitz]
BAM!
Before Celeste or her twin could even raise their swords or react to the movement, Tasmin materialized directly in front of Celeste’s face.
Without drawing a weapon, Tasmin drove a brutal and heavily reinforced elbow straight into Celeste’s nose!
CRACK!
A sickening crunch of shattered bone echoed through the crater.

Celeste’s head was violently thrust backward at a terrifying angle as a fountain of crimson blood erupted from her broken nose, spraying across the dirt as her body was launched thirty feet backward, crashing hard against the rocks!
Tasmin landed lightly on her toes, her posture completely relaxed as she looked down at the bleeding, gasping priestess.
"I don’t really give a damn about all of that villain speech nonsense..." Tasmin spoke softly.
HUMMMMM!
[ACTIVE SKILL ACTIVATED: Shadow Strengthening]
Suddenly, thick pitch-black void shadows erupted directly from Tasmin’s crimson eyes!
The shadow aura around her physical form flared wildly, shaping into terrifying demonic wings behind her back, while a gorgeous devilishly wicked smile spread across her flawless face.
She looked like a supreme, unholy Shadow Empress who had descended onto the mortal world to claim souls.

Tasmin looked straight at the camera lens of a hovering streaming drone ten feet away, her crimson eyes burning with an intoxicating charm as she delivered her words to the five hundred million viewers watching across the globe.
"You see... our Lord Vespera told me that the rest of the Human world is watching us today."
Tasmin raised her hand, her twin weapons spinning hypnotically around her fingers, her smile turning completely irresistible.
"So keep making me look cool to both my Lord... and my fans, okay?"
BOOM!
BOOM!
BOOM!
A blinding superheated blast of pure light shot through the dust-choked air, missing the back of Tasmin’s neck by a mere fraction of an inch.

The concentrated beam of light slammed directly into the pile of fallen soldiers behind her, instantly incinerating the corpses into black ash and releasing a wave of dry suffocating heat that rippled across the entire crater!
High above the field, hovering against the gray clouds, the second twin sister...
Hana had taken to the sky.
Her pristine white priestess robes billowed wildly in the wind with her white eyes burning with divine fury as she channeled her light magic into the heavens!
FWOOSH!
FWOOSH!
FWOOSH!
A terrifying rain of weapons constructed entirely from solid, superheated solar magic descended from the sky.

Dozens of glowing white spears, lances, and javelins rained down upon the earth, tearing through the air with deafening, whistling shrieks as they bombarded the ground around Tasmin in a continuous, explosive carpet-bombing.
BOOM!
KABOOM!
BOOM!
Plumes of earth, shattered bedrock, and golden fire erupted across the clearing!
Yet, through the chaotic storm of falling solar artillery, Tasmin’s crimson eyes remained completely and unyieldingly locked onto her primary target...
Celeste Sunsword.
Celeste was hovering five feet off the grass, suspended inside a churning, miniature tornado of swirling white light.
Her face was pale, covered in dirt and sweat, as her broken bloody nose dripped crimson drops down her chin.
She was frantically backpedaling across the field, her eyes wide with a mixture of terror and rage as she kept her crystal rapier pointed straight at the approaching shadow mage.
"STAY BACK, YOU FILTHY SHADOW DEMON!" Celeste shrieked at the top of her lungs, spitting bloody saliva from her lips as she unleashed spell after spell.
"DON’T YOU COME ANY CLOSER TO ME!
GET AWAY!"
Tasmin sprinted effortlessly through the cratered terrain, her boots gliding across the soil like a hunting panther.
She tilted her head, her dark pigtails swaying behind her ears as a smooth mocking grin spread across her lips.
"My, my, Celeste..." Tasmin called out, her voice easily cutting through the thunderous explosions of light behind her.
"Aren’t you supposed to be a divine High Priestess of Light from The Unmovable Wall?
Are holy priestesses even allowed to curse and scream like hysterical street urchins?
What would your devoted followers on the stream think if they heard you right now?"
"SHUT UP!
SHUT YOUR FILTHY MOUTH!" Celeste screamed frantically with her noble composure completely shattered.
She thrust her crystal rapier forward in a wild uncontrolled sequence...
FWOOSH!
FWOOSH!
FWOOSH!
A dozen massive lances of pure light materialized around her floating form, shooting forward in a dense fan-shaped barrage designed to impale Tasmin’s limbs.
Tasmin’s hands blurred...
She unholstered her twin shortswords with her fingers locking tightly around the dark steel hilts while the Eclipse-Thread chains wrapped securely around her forearms.
CLANG!
CRACK!
Instead of retreating into the shadows, Tasmin stepped directly into the path of the incoming solar lances.
She spun her right shortsword like a glowing dark-purple boomerang, launching the chained blade through the air.
The void-infused steel sliced cleanly through the first three light lances, bisecting the dense magic mid-air and detonating them into harmless sparks of white fire.
Celeste’s jaw dropped in shock.
"W-What?!
That’s solid light magic!
How are your daggers cutting through my spells?!"
"Did you forget who forged these blades, darling?" Tasmin chuckled, flicking her wrist to snap the chained shortsword back into her palm.
"Our Master Smith doesn’t make toys!"
"I DON’T CARE!
DIE!" Celeste shrieked with her fingers twitching violently as she summoned twenty more lances of light, filling the entire corridor between them with a solid wall of searing energy.
Seeing the impassable wall of superheated light rushing toward her, Tasmin didn’t stop.
Her crimson eyes glinted with sharp reckless genius.
STEP!
Tasmin launched herself into the air, driving the tip of her left shortsword directly into the center of the lead solar lance!
HISSSSSSS!

chapters.title: Chapter 306: Kill Or Be Killed [Bonus - ]
paragraphs: The superheated energy flared violently against the sole of her leather combat boot.
Even through the fire-resistant enchantments built into her footwear, the intense solar heat burned into her skin, causing a sharp flare of pain to shoot up her leg.
Tasmin gritted her teeth tightly with her jaw setting into a hard unyielding line.
’Pain is just information,’ Tasmin reminded herself.
Using the solid surface of the flying light lance as a temporary stepping stone for a fraction of a second, Tasmin pushed off with explosive force.
SWISH!
She leaped to the next lance, then the next, vaulting across the floating salvo of solar weapons like a phantom dancing on falling leaves.
With every leap, the intense thermal heat scorched her boots, but Tasmin ignored the sensation completely, rapidly closing the fifty-yard gap between herself and the floating priestess.
Out from the upper corner of Tasmin’s vision, a blinding reflection of golden light flickered in the clouds!
Hana... still hovering high above had anticipated Tasmin’s aerial trajectory.
She raised her arms, sending her massive, eight-foot-long Greatsword of Holy Light plummeting down from the sky once again, aiming to crush Tasmin mid-air!
FWOOOOOOSH!
The massive golden greatsword cut through the atmosphere with the force of a falling meteor.
Tasmin’s twitched with a wicked confident grin breaking across her face.
’You might have gotten me with that trick the first time...’ Tasmin thought smoothly, ’...but I never fall for the same move twice!’

Instead of trying to dodge the falling greatsword, Tasmin adjusted her body angle mid-air, kicking off the side of a flying solar lance and diving directly into the slipstream of the descending greatsword.
BOOM!
The giant holy blade crashed into the dirt ten feet below, generating a massive, vertical shockwave of wind and pressure.
Tasmin caught the edge of that exploding shockwave, utilizing the upward air current like a slingshot.
Her body accelerated past supersonic speeds, blurring into an invisible shadow stream that shot straight through Celeste’s defensive light tornado.
"WHAT?!" Celeste gasped, her wide bloodshot eyes locking onto the shadow emerging directly in front of her chest.
Before Celeste could even raise her rapier—
STAB!
Tasmin drove her right shortsword deep into Celeste’s upper abdomen!
PFT!
The steel penetrated cleanly through her pristine white robes, slicing through skin and muscle until the hilt slammed flat against Celeste’s ribs!
"GHAHHHM!" Celeste let out a wet strangled gasp with thick crimson blood bursting from her lips and spraying across Tasmin’s cheek.
Desperate, dying rage flared in Celeste’s eyes! She raised her crystal rapier, trying to drive the point into Tasmin’s throat—
...But Tasmin was already three steps ahead.
PULL! STEP!
Tasmin forcefully yanked her shortsword out from Celeste’s gut, bringing her boot up and driving a heavy, full-force push-kick flat into Celeste’s chest.
BAM!
The impact launched Tasmin backward through the air, while sending Celeste plummeting straight down toward the earth...
At that exact second—
WHIP-CRACK!
From the sky above, Hana had just unleashed a colossal sixty-foot whip constructed from solid solar light, aiming to strike Tasmin where she had been floating!
Because Celeste had just been kicked into that exact position by Tasmin...
KABOOM!
Hana’s own superheated light whip struck her sister, Celeste, directly in the back.
A blinding explosive detonation of white light and shockwaves erupted upon impact.
"GAH!"
Celeste was slammed violently into the hard bedrock, creating a deep fifteen-foot crater in the ground as the holy light whipped across her body, scorching her robes and breaking her remaining ribs.
SWISH.
Tasmin executed a fluid, graceful mid-air rotation with her boots touching down lightly on the edge of the crater fifty yards away.
She lowered her shortswords, looking down into the smoking pit.
Inside the crater, Celeste Sunsword lay face down in the dirt, her body trembling weakly and her pristine white robes charred black.
She was still barely alive, her fingers feebly twitching in the soil as she gasped for air... but her combat capability was completely ruined. Well until she got healed at the very least.
Tasmin narrowed her crimson eyes, evaluating the broken priestess.
’She’s wide open...’ Tasmin analyzed internally. ’If I execute her right now, that eliminates one Hero permanently...’
Before Tasmin could step forward to deliver the final killing blow...
BOOM!
The air behind Tasmin shattered.
A colossal white-hot fist surrounded by swirling light magic crashed directly into the side of Tasmin’s face with the force of a battering ram.
The shockwave from the strike blew away the surrounding dust and rock for thirty yards.
...However, the moment the fist made contact with her cheek—
SWRRRRH!
There was no crunch of bone and there was no spray of blood.
The physical form of Tasmin dissolved into a swirling, harmless vortex of murky shadow smoke.
The punch had struck nothing more than a Tier 2 [Shadow Decoy]!
Hana landed heavily on the grass where the decoy had dissolved, her gloved fist still extended with her knuckles glowing with heat.
Her white eyes blinked in realization as she looked down at her hands.
"Ha—"
Ten feet away, emerging smoothly from the shadow cast by a large boulder, Tasmin materialized.
She uncrossed her arms, leaning her hip casually against the stone as she looked at Hana’s pale trembling face with a long dramatic sigh.

"You know..." Tasmin spoke, her voice carrying a dry scolding tone. "...if you had been even a tiny bit cautious about your surrounding environment, you wouldn’t be throwing those massive light weapons around so recklessly and blowing up your own sister."
Hana’s face turned ghostly white.
She slowly turned her head, her trembling gaze landing on the crater where Celeste lay broken and bleeding from the strike of her own light whip.
A wave of suffocating sickening guilt washed over Hana’s heart.
Her teeth clenched together so tightly they threatened to shatter, and her breath hitched in her throat as she choked out.
"I... I know... I KNOW!"
Hana gritted her teeth with her hands shaking violently at her sides.
As a high-tier Light Specialist, she had been supremely confident before stepping onto this field.
She had assumed that facing a shadow user would be an effortless walk in the park since it was a simple matter of illuminating the field and burning the dark magic away.
She had never imagined that a shadow user could possess this level of god-tier combat instinct, speed, and spatial awareness.
At Tasmin’s Level, her shadow magic had developed a dense elemental resistance against light magic...
Tasmin wasn’t just hiding in the dark like one would expect... she was actively using their own light spells as footstools and blinding smoke to manipulate the battlefield!
’I don’t want to die...’ Hana told herself internally with her heart hammering against her ribs like a trapped bird. ’I don’t want to die here... and I won’t let Celeste die either!’
Hana’s eyes flared, turning completely white.
If she wanted to survive this battle, if she wanted to protect her broken sister and fulfill Lord Sky’s explicit orders, she had to execute her mission with uncompromising lethality.
HUMMMMMMM!
An overwhelming aura of superheated white light erupted from Hana’s body, illuminating the entire clearing in a blinding heavenly glare.
She reached out her right hand, catching the handle of the Greatsword of Holy Light as it flew out of the dirt and slotted firmly into her grip.
Hana raised the massive blade, pointing the glowing tip directly at Tasmin’s eyes, her voice echoing with a cold vow.
"Your very next breath... will be your last!"
BOOOOOOM!
Hana charged.
The ground beneath her boots shattered into powder as she accelerated across the terrain at high speed, swinging the massive Greatsword of Holy Light in a sweeping horizontal cleave.
CLANG!
Tasmin raised both of her shortswords, crossing the void-infused blades in an X-block to absorb the heavy downward strike.
The absurd physical force behind the blow slammed into Tasmin’s arms.
HISSSSSSS!
Even though Tasmin’s Level 30 stats held firm, the extreme thermal heat radiating from the holy greatsword instantly scorched the soil beneath her feet...
Tasmin was pushed backward a full twenty meters across the grass with the soles of her leather boots leaving two thick glowing red lines of melted dirt trailing down the field!
Tasmin’s boots came to a halt. She wiped a tiny drop of sweat from her forehead, shooting Hana a dangerous smirk.
"Is that all the weight you’ve got behind that big sword, darling?" Tasmin taunted smoothly. "My Lord hits ten times harder than that when she’s just playing around!"
Hearing her strike dismissed so easily, Hana’s eyes narrowed in rage.
She suddenly pulled her greatsword back, dropping her defensive guard and leaving her entire torso completely exposed to an immediate counterattack.
It was a blatant deliberate opening.
...However, Tasmin was no naive amateur.
She recognized a lethal trap the second it presented itself so instead of capitalizing on the open gap and lunging forward...
Tasmin drove her heels into the soil, executing an instantaneous high-speed backward dash.
FWOOSH!
That decision saved her life.
The exact second Tasmin retreated ten yards backward, the space where she had been standing exploded in a blinding, nuclear pillar of solar light.
The trap spell Hana had primed beneath the dirt detonated, completely eviscerating the surrounding bedrock and melting the soil into glowing, red-hot glass.
BOOM!
Through the thick rising white smoke of the explosion—
Hana burst forward like a white phantom...
She held five glowing light lances in her left hand, thrusting them forward in a rapid lethal stabbing combination toward Tasmin’s throat.
THWIP!
Tasmin vanished into thin air!
Hana’s white eyes scanned the smoke instantly.

As an experienced Hero, she knew how standard shadow users operated... ninety-nine percent of them reflexively glided into their opponent’s physical shadow or merged with the nearest dark obstacle behind them.
Hana didn’t hesitate.

She swung her free hand, summoning a dozen light daggers and spreading them in a wide, three-hundred-and-sixty-degree circle around her own shadow and the surrounding rocks, seeking to impale Tasmin the second she emerged.
"Come on out, hiding won’t save you!"
...However, Tasmin didn’t pop out from the shadows on the ground. Hell she didn’t pop out from behind the rocks.
SWISH!
Tasmin materialized directly above Hana’s head... emerging from the microscopic shadow cast by Hana’s own floating white silk cloak.
"Looking the wrong way." Tasmin’s voice said from above!
Tasmin flicked her right wrist, launching her chained shortsword straight down at Hana’s shoulder and the blade crackled violently with dark shadow magic!
CLANG!
Hana reacted with terrifying speed, summoning a small, circular light shield over her shoulder to deflect the shortsword.
The void blade struck the light shield, bouncing off the surface with a loud metallic ring!
Hana sneered up at her.
"Ha! A small shield is more than enough to deflect your tiny daggers—"
"Heh..." Tasmin smirked mid-air.
Before Hana could understand what was happening, Tasmin’s fingers twitched!
’Chain Execution...’
SWIRL!
The Eclipse-Thread chain attached to the floating shortsword came alive like a living metallic serpent.
Super-heated crimson flames and shadow magic crackled along the metal links as the chain wrapped tightly around Hana’s light shield, her arm, and her torso in three tight loops.
"WHAT?!" Hana gasped with her arm pinned securely against her ribs.
Tasmin dropped down from the air, grabbing the main chain with both hands, using her body weight and momentum to execute a violent mid-air rotation!
"Here we go!"
Tasmin slammed Hana forcefully flat into the hard ground!
KABAM!
Hana’s body struck the soil with immense impact.
She let out a painful bloody cough with her fingers losing their grip on the Greatsword of Holy Light as the massive weapon tumbled away across the grass.
Tasmin landed gracefully on her feet, yanking the chain back to retract her shortsword into her palm.
Hana scrambled frantically on the dirt, summoning a light dagger into her hand as she pushed herself up.
"Come at me!"
Tasmin sprinted straight toward her.
"Sure..."
CLANG! CLANG! CLANG! CLANG!
The two women engaged in a high-speed melee clash at point-blank range.
Blades turned into continuous blinding blurs of white and dark-purple light.
Sparks flew wildly across the field as shortsword met light dagger in a rapid sequence of parries, thrusts, and counter-strikes.
They traded sharp biting taunts between every clash with their movements executing at such speeds that left the five hundred million viewers watching the stream in breathtaking awe.
SWISH!
Tasmin ducked beneath a wild desperate slash from Hana’s light dagger!
Finding a micro-gap in Hana’s frantic defensive posture, Tasmin thrust her left shortsword straight upward with terrifying precision.
The shadow-infused tip of the blade penetrated cleanly through Hana’s right eye socket!
"AHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!"

She swung her free hand, summoning a dozen light daggers and spreading them in a wide, three-hundred-and-sixty-degree circle around her own shadow and the surrounding rocks, seeking to impale Tasmin the second she emerged.
"Come on out, hiding won’t save you!"
...However, Tasmin didn’t pop out from the shadows on the ground.
Hell she didn’t pop out from behind the rocks.
SWISH!
Tasmin materialized directly above Hana’s head... emerging from the microscopic shadow cast by Hana’s own floating white silk cloak.
"Looking the wrong way." Tasmin’s voice said from above!
Tasmin flicked her right wrist, launching her chained shortsword straight down at Hana’s shoulder and the blade crackled violently with dark shadow magic!
CLANG!
Hana reacted with terrifying speed, summoning a small, circular light shield over her shoulder to deflect the shortsword.
The void blade struck the light shield, bouncing off the surface with a loud metallic ring!
Hana sneered up at her.
"Ha!
A small shield is more than enough to deflect your tiny daggers—"
"Heh..." Tasmin smirked mid-air.
Before Hana could understand what was happening, Tasmin’s fingers twitched!
’Chain Execution...’
SWIRL!
The Eclipse-Thread chain attached to the floating shortsword came alive like a living metallic serpent.
Super-heated crimson flames and shadow magic crackled along the metal links as the chain wrapped tightly around Hana’s light shield, her arm, and her torso in three tight loops.
"WHAT?!" Hana gasped with her arm pinned securely against her ribs.
Tasmin dropped down from the air, grabbing the main chain with both hands, using her body weight and momentum to execute a violent mid-air rotation!
"Here we go!"
Tasmin slammed Hana forcefully flat into the hard ground!
KABAM!
Hana’s body struck the soil with immense impact.
She let out a painful bloody cough with her fingers losing their grip on the Greatsword of Holy Light as the massive weapon tumbled away across the grass.
Tasmin landed gracefully on her feet, yanking the chain back to retract her shortsword into her palm.
Hana scrambled frantically on the dirt, summoning a light dagger into her hand as she pushed herself up.
"Come at me!"
Tasmin sprinted straight toward her.
"Sure..."
CLANG!
CLANG!
CLANG!
CLANG!
The two women engaged in a high-speed melee clash at point-blank range.
Blades turned into continuous blinding blurs of white and dark-purple light.
Sparks flew wildly across the field as shortsword met light dagger in a rapid sequence of parries, thrusts, and counter-strikes.
They traded sharp biting taunts between every clash with their movements executing at such speeds that left the five hundred million viewers watching the stream in breathtaking awe.
SWISH!
Tasmin ducked beneath a wild desperate slash from Hana’s light dagger!
Finding a micro-gap in Hana’s frantic defensive posture, Tasmin thrust her left shortsword straight upward with terrifying precision.
The shadow-infused tip of the blade penetrated cleanly through Hana’s right eye socket!
"AHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!"

chapters.title: Chapter 307: Shadow Domain [Bonus - ]
paragraphs: "AGHHHHHHHH!"
An agonizing blood-curdling scream of pure torture erupted from Hana’s throat.
Blood and eye fluid sprayed into the air as the bleed effect took hold inside her optical nerve.
In frantic agony, Hana brought her boot up, driving a desperate, full-force kick flat into Tasmin’s stomach.
BAM!
The heavy kick forced Tasmin to stagger three paces backward with her boot soles scraping against the dirt as she pulled her blade free.
Hana clutched her bleeding ruined eye socket with her left hand, screaming in agony, while wildly swinging her light dagger with her right hand in a blind arc.
"FUCK YOU! FUCK YOU! FUCK YOU!"
Tasmin easily swayed her head to the right, dodging the wild strike.
WHOOSH!
’She’s open...’
Upon seeing the opening, Tasmin drove a swift precise kick flat into Hana’s right wrist.
THWACK!
The light dagger was forcefully knocked clean out of Hana’s hand, flying through the air and shattering into harmless light motes.
Tasmin lowered her blades with her crimson eyes looking down at the bleeding Hero with a cool smile.
"You need total mental control and emotional focus to cast high-tier spells, don’t you?" Tasmin remarked smoothly. "That’s what all mages need to maintain their spells after all..."
Tasmin didn’t use her shortswords this time. She shot forward, driving a bare, reinforced fist straight across Hana’s jaw.
’I shouldn’t even give her time to think...’
BAM!
Hana’s head snapped sideways with blood spraying from her lips.
"Ghk-!"
Hana frantically tried to ignite a light burst from her palm to blast Tasmin away, but Tasmin’s reflexes were far too fast.
WHOOSH!
Tasmin effortlessly ducked under the palm strike, stepping into Hana’s guard, and delivered a devastating brutal left hook flat into her cheekbone!
BAM!
Before Hana could regain her footing, Tasmin executed a swift spinning back-kick directly into Hana’s mouth.
CRACK!
Several broken bloody teeth flew out from Hana’s mouth, bouncing across the dirt as she stumbled backward, her vision swimming in total agony.
’I... I have to protect my sister...’ Hana thought through the blinding pain with her white eye trembling. ’I have to... protect Celeste...’
Spurred by pure desperate survival instinct, Hana forced herself into a rigid, hand-to-hand defensive stance.
She charged forward at the exact second Tasmin stepped in.
BAM! CRK! BAM!
The two women engaged in a fierce brutal hand-to-hand brawl inside the dust cloud.

Punches, elbow strikes, and knee thrusts were traded at high speed and while Tasmin dodged most of the incoming strikes with fluid grace landing heavy bone-crunching counter-punches across Hana’s ribs and face.
The same thing could not be said for Hana.𝒻𝘳𝘦𝘦𝘸ℯ𝒷𝘯𝘰𝑣ℯ𝑙.𝘤𝑜𝘮
BAM!
Another tooth flew out of her mouth as her vision began to swim.
"Gah!"
Suddenly...
Hana found a tiny desperate opening in Tasmin’s forward upper-body rotation.
She didn’t hesitate after that as she channeled every remaining drop of her magic into her right hand, forming a jagged six-inch Dagger of Pure Light.
"DIE!"
Hana drove the light dagger straight into the right side of Tasmin’s neck.
The glowing white blade penetrated deep into the flesh, going three inches deep near her collarbone.
Hana’s face twisted into a maniacal blood-stained grin as she leaned in close to Tasmin’s smiling face, spitting blood as she cursed her out loud.
"DIE! DIE! I GOT YOU, YOU SMIRKING BITCH! PURGE IN HOLY LIGHT!"
Hana forcefully yanked the light dagger back out, expecting a fountain of thick red arterial blood to gush from Tasmin’s neck...
...But no red blood came out.
SWRRRRH!
From the deep wound in Tasmin’s neck... thick, murky, and pitch-black Shadow poured out like living liquid.
The physical vessel that Hana had just stabbed wasn’t flesh and blood... it was Tasmin’s primary [Shadow Strengthening] physical hull!
Tasmin’s smile didn’t fade for a single microsecond.
In fact, her smile grew even wider and her eyes had shadow coming out of them.
’Since you want to be used so badly... Let me use you as a test subject.’
Tasmin reached out both of her bare hands, placing them flat and firmly onto Hana’s trembling shoulders, locking the Hero in an inescapable vice-like grip.
Tasmin leaned her head down with her lips hovering right next to Hana’s ear, and whispered in a low chilling voice.
"Tch... I didn’t really want to do this to you... but you leave me no choice."
’What does she mea—’
"Drown in darkness."
HUMMMMMMMMM!
The exact second the words left Tasmin’s lips—
The entire world around the two of them... the clearing, the dust cloud, the sky, the sun, and the distant battlefield was completely erased.
WHOOSH!
An impenetrable sphere of pure pitch-black Darkness consumed the space, swallowing Hana, Tasmin, and the surrounding terrain in endless night.
Inside the dense suffocating sphere of pure void darkness, the world had ceased to exist.
There was no sky, no ground, no wind, and no sound from the ongoing battle outside.
There was only a pitch-black abyss that felt unnatural, unnatural in a way that made the skin crawl and the stomach turn.
The air inside the dome wasn’t just dark... It was unnaturally cold.
’It’s not normal cold though...’
It was a creeping frost that seeped straight through skin and cloth, settling deep inside the bones like liquid ice.
Hana stood in the center of the pitch-black void, her chest heaving violently as cold sweat poured down her pale blood-stained face.
Her single remaining eye widened in horror, staring wildly into the endless blackness around her.
"W-What is this...?" Hana choked out, her voice sounding muffled and distorted as if the darkness itself was swallowing her words right out of her mouth. "Light... I need light...!"
Hana reached into her spiritual core, desperately trying to pull forth even a microscopic spark of light magic.
She raised her trembling right hand, willing her light magic to ignite, to form a torch, a dagger, a needle... anything to pierce the suffocating gloom.
HISSS...
Nothing happened.
A hollow empty ache throbbed inside her chest. Her mana pool was completely dry.
The high-tier light spells, the giant Greatsword of Holy Light, the rain of light weapons, and the final dagger strike had completely drained every single drop of magic from her body.
Her spiritual pathways were exhausted, bone-dry, and flickering on the edge of total collapse.
TAP... TAP... TAP...
A chilling sound echoed from directly behind her.
Hana’s spine went rigid.
The hair on her arms stood straight up as an icy, spine-chilling wave of dread washed over her neck.
The temperature inside the dome dropped another ten degrees with the air becoming so frigid that her ragged breath misted in white clouds before her face.
Slowly, terrifyingly, Hana turned her head.
Standing less than three feet behind her in the pitch-black void was a towering ghostly silhouette.
It was composed entirely of writhing, unnatural shadow smoke, its form indistinct and shifting like a specter born from a nightmare.
It had no face, no eyes, and no features... only two burning, crimson pinpricks of light where its eyes should be, staring down at her with cold hunger.
It was like a predator looking down on its prey and it made her scared... as the shadow stalked her silently, gliding across the non-existent floor like a phantom in the dark.
"STAY AWAY FROM ME!" Hana shrieked with panic overriding her exhaustion!
She threw her body forward, swinging her right fist with all the physical strength left in her body.
Her knuckles cut through the chilly air, striking the ghostly shadow figure squarely in the center of its chest.
THWIP!
Her fist passed straight through the smoky silhouette as if striking thin air.
The shadow figure didn’t flinch, nor did it bleed... it simply dissolved into a cloud of harmless dark mist, swirling away into the surrounding gloom.
Hana stumbled forward from her own momentum, panting heavily as her boots scraped against the unseen ground.
She spun around wildly with her single eye searching the pitch-black void.
TAP... TAP... TAP...
The sound echoed again and this time from her left.
The ghostly shadow figure materialized once more out of the dark, towering over her, its burning crimson eyes locking onto her face with that same eerie silent judgment.
"DIE! GET OUT OF MY HEAD!" Hana screamed, her mind fraying at the edges.
She lashed out with a desperate full-force side kick with her boot whistling through the chilly air toward the phantom’s neck.
SWISH!
The shadow figure phased out of existence a split second before her foot made contact making her leg swing uselessly through empty space.
Frustration, fear, and exhaustion boiled over inside Hana’s chest.
She clutched her bleeding eye socket with one hand, her teeth grinding together so hard her jaw ached as she screamed into the empty darkness.
"YOU COWARD! STOP HIDING IN THE DARK! FIGHT ME LIKE A REAL HERO, YOU SHADOW DEMON! SHOW YOURSELF AND FIGHT!"
Her hysterical voice echoed through the chilly void, bouncing off the invisible walls of the dome in distorted overlapping reverberations.
Then, out of the silent blackness... a single chillingly calm voice answered her.
"Okay."
BOOOOOOOOOOM!
Before Hana’s mind could even register the sound, a bare shadow-infused fist exploded out from the dark, striking her squarely across her jaw.
The staggering force behind the strike was catastrophic.
CRACK!
Hana’s jawbone shattered instantly... The impact was so immense that it didn’t just throw her body as it generated a violent shockwave that blasted outward in a thirty-foot radius.
KABAGHHH!
The force of the punch literally burst a massive, twenty-foot hole through the thick wall of the dark dome itself.
Sunbeams and battlefield dust poured through the jagged breach as Hana’s body was launched out of the shadow domain like a cannonball.
She shot across the open air, crashing hard onto the damp grass, and skidded backward for forty yards across the dirt before tumbling head-over-heels into the crater where her twin sister lay.
Hana’s body crashed heavily beside Celeste’s broken form, her single remaining eye rolling back into her head as total sweet unconsciousness claimed her mind.
Both of Lord Sky’s elite Light Specialists lay completely out of it, battered, broken, and defeated in the pit.
Out on the open clearing, the massive, chilly dome of darkness began to crack, fracture, and dissolve into thin air.
The thick void smoke dissipated into the atmosphere, revealing Tasmin standing in the center of the trampled grass.
Her dark pigtails fluttered in the morning breeze, and her dark tunic was torn at the collar where Hana had stabbed her earlier.
Her chest rose and fell in heavy deliberate rhythms as she let out a slow, deep breath, wiping a tiny trickle of sweat from her forehead with the back of her gloved hand.
"Huuuuh..."
’Maintaining that domain is no joke. The strain on the core is completely different from basic shadow usage.’
Despite her heavy breathing, a bright satisfied grin broke across Tasmin’s face.
’I’m actually getting the hang of this domain stuff,’ she thought proudly, looking down at her hands as dark residual shadow sparks danced across her fingertips.

Ever since she had watched Brida deploy her [Domain Barrier: Bastion Ground] during their earlier team drills, Tasmin had been obsessed with the concept of expanding her own shadow aura into a territory, like a Domain.

Brida’s barrier was a solid bedrock-anchored defensive dome, but Tasmin had realized that if she inverted the structural principle... turning the barrier inside out to trap an enemy in total elemental isolation... she could create a pocket realm of darkness.
And this one was quite different from the one she used against those people of Unmovable Wall earlier.

’It’s incredible,’ Tasmin reflected internally, analyzing the technique’s mechanics. ’Brida makes it look so effortless because her Vitality pool is ridiculous, but keeping a closed shadow domain going while simultaneously attempting to construct high-tier offensive spells inside it... that is a nightmare for mana management. If I had tried to cast a shadow spell inside there while maintaining the wall’s integrity, my pathways would have overloaded...’
Still, the results spoke for themselves.
She had completely dismantled two high-tier Light-Specialist Classic Heroes without suffering a single point of serious damage.
Tasmin turned her boots, slowly approaching the crater where the twin sisters lay unconscious and bleeding.
Her twin shortswords hung idly at her hips with the Eclipse-Thread chains rattling softly against her armor.

Originally, when this fight had started, Tasmin’s instincts as a hunter had dictated a simple conclusion: slit their throats, destroy their cores, and ensure two of Lord Sky’s valuable Heroes were permanently removed from the war board.
...But as the fight had progressed, Tasmin had actually gotten a massive kick out of the chaotic challenge of it.

’To be honest...’ Tasmin admitted in her internal thoughts with a hidden smirk touching her heart, ’...that was actually fun. Fighting two Heroes who specifically counter my element... there were at least three separate occasions where I could have been seriously injured if I had miscalculated my timing by a second.’

chapters.title: Chapter 308: Unstoppable Object Meets An Unmovable Wall [Bonus - ]
paragraphs: She looked down at the twin sisters resting side by side in the dirt.
Despite her ruthless reputation on the battlefield, Tasmin decided she wasn’t going to kill them.
Slaying two unconscious helpless opponents who had fought with everything they had didn’t fit the grand narrative Silas wanted for this broadcast.
But she certainly wasn’t going to make it easy on them or leave them with their pride intact.
Tasmin stopped at the edge of the crater, looking down at the unconscious twins.
She puffing out her chest slightly, tilting her head up, and began speaking aloud in an exaggerated arrogant noble tone.

"Hmph! Be grateful, you pathetic light-dwelling worms! I, Tasmin of the Blessed Land, shall magnanimously grant you your pitiful lives today! Rest in the dirt, grow stronger, refine your crude techniques, and perhaps... just perhaps... you may one day be worthy of standing before my shadow once again!"
She paused with dramatic silence settling over the crater.
Tasmin smoothly turned on her heel, her dark cloak fluttering behind her as she looked across the field toward the trail of absolute destruction Brida had carved through Sky’s people.
In the back of her mind, Tasmin winced slightly with her hand instinctively drifting down to rest on the hilt of her shortsword.

’Wait...’ Tasmin thought, her eyes narrowing as she mentally recalled the dozens of stories in the library she had analyzed in her free time. ’Usually, when an antagonist or rival character spares a pair of defeated Heroes while talking down to them like an arrogant noble... doesn’t one of them suddenly trigger a dramatic rage-induced power-up from the dirt and try to sneak-attack from behind?’
Tasmin held her breath with her boots planted firmly in the soil and her ears perked up to catch the slightest sound of a sudden mana eruption or a dramatic tearful battle cry.
Five seconds passed...
Ten seconds passed...
The wind whistled softly across the empty field.
Nothing happened.
The twins remained completely passed out in the crater, snoring softly amidst the shattered rocks.
Tasmin blinked her crimson eyes, a soft surprised noise escaping her lips.
"Hm?"
She blinked again, looking back over her shoulder at the motionless bodies, then let out a quiet amused chuckle at her own overthinking.
Without wasting another second, Tasmin kicked off the ground, blurring into a high-speed shadow stream as she ran off in the direction Brida had charged.
Meanwhile, five hundred yards further down the central clearing...
BOOM! BOOM! KABOOM!
"GWAHAHAHAHAHA! OUT OF THE WAY, YOU BASTARDS!" Brida’s boisterous thunderous laughter echoed across the entire basin.
The Level 30 S-Rank [Grand Titan Bastion] was having the time of her life.

She was surging across the battlefield like a five-hundred-ton armored juggernaut, holding her massive Steel Aegis shield flat before her chest while swinging her double-bitted Cleaver in massive devastating arcs with her free hand.
CRUNCH! KABAM!
Every time her shield slammed into Sky’s supercharged soldiers, men were sent flying eighty feet into the air like broken toys.
Shields crumbled, spears snapped like dry twigs, and heavy plate armor was flattened flat against the dirt.
Unlike Tasmin, who viewed battle as a precise art form dedicated to her Lord, Brida approached warfare with pure joy.
She didn’t feel a single drop of remorse or pity for the enemy soldiers trying to block her path...
This was what she was summoned for!
However, despite her bloodthirsty excitement, Brida remained disciplined enough to follow Fenna’s explicit request.

Every time a female soldier or archer appeared in her path, Brida didn’t execute a lethal axe strike... Instead, she used the flat, broad face of her Steel Aegis to forcefully shove them out of the way, ragdolling them into the soft dirt without crushing their vital organs.
"CLEAR A PATH!" Brida roared, her eyes burning like twin furnace fires behind her visor.
Far across the field, standing on the command deck of The Unmovable Wall, Lord Sky watched the single-handed devastation through his helmet’s zoom lenses, his jaw clenching beneath his disguise.

’She’s tearing through our forward infantry like they’re made of wet paper...’ Sky analyzed rapidly, his Cinstincts calculating the massive loss of momentum. ’Even with Elm’s 10x stat buff, standard infantry can’t bridge the structural gap against her. If she reaches our lower gun decks, the artillery array is finished.’
Beside Sky’s command vehicle, a massive figure stepped forward from the ranks of the elite territory guards.
He was not a Hero.
He possessed no title... He was a standard high-tier territory troop who had risen through the ranks purely through brutal physical conditioning, heavy battle experience, and stubborn willpower.
He stood nearly six-foot-eight, his bare arms so violently jacked that thick, rope-like veins bulged across his dark skin like living roots.

He wore heavy, black iron chest armor, and gripped in his right hand was a massive, eight-foot-tall Tower Shield forged from solid, unrefined dark-iron alloy... a shield that weighed well over eight hundred pounds.
The man turned his broad head toward Sky, lowering his head in a respectful, iron-clad bow.
"Lord Sky," the man rumbled, his voice sounding like two heavy boulders grinding together. "Allow me to halt her charge."
Sky looked at the massive troop, a sharp glint of pride flashing behind his helmet display.
Even though this man was not an officially summoned Hero... his raw physical stats, shield techniques, and defensive stubbornness were easily equal to many of Sky’s own Hero-class combatants.
If there was a single man in The Unmovable Wall who truly embodied the territorial title of their home... it was him.
Sky offered a firm, decisive nod.
"Go, Hog. Show them why our territory bears that name!"
"Understood!" Hog barked out.
Without another word, Hog turned his massive frame toward the battlefield.
BOOM!
Despite his colossal size and heavy iron tower shield, Hog burst forward with terrifying explosive speed.
He sprinted across the field, moving far ahead of the territory’s stationary cannon lines, his heavy iron boots leaving deep shattered footprints in the dirt.
As he closed in on Brida’s incoming trajectory, Hog raised his free hand, barking out loud commands to the scattered soldiers scrambling in front of him.
"CLEAR THE CORRIDOR! ALL UNITS, SEPARATE TO THE FLANKS NOW! MOVE!"

Sky’s infantry soldiers, hearing Hog’s thunderous command, scrambled frantically to the left and right, completely clearing a wide, two-hundred-yard straight runway through the center of the battlefield.
The sudden clearing left Brida on a full-on crash course straight toward Hog.
Charging down the open runway at high speeds, Brida’s sharp red eyes locked onto the jacked man standing in the distance with his towering iron shield.
’Tch...’ Brida thought inwardly, her brows furrowing slightly beneath her helmet. ’They’ve figured out the weakness of my charge.’
Brida’s [Aegis Charge] was a devastating unstoppable skill, but its fundamental mechanics were straightforward.
Because she was building up thousands of pounds of forward momentum with every stride, changing directions mid-charge or swerving around a target was virtually impossible.
Once she locked onto a straight line, she was locked in until impact.

’Bah, whatever,’ Brida grumbled in her thoughts with a feral grin returning to her face. ’I’ve killed enough nameless cannon fodder for one morning anyway. Running over weaklings gets boring after a while.’
From what her high-tier senses could perceive across the battlefield, Tasmin had just concluded her own high-level battle against those twin light girls and emerged victorious.

’Tasmin got to have a real fight...’ Brida thought, her blood pumping with fierce competitive excitement. ’I need a proper heavy-weight clash of my own! I’m not letting her steal the entire broadcast spotlight!’
Behind her, seeing Hog set up his iron defensive stance in the distance, Fenna and Gunnhild immediately recognized the situation.
With practiced synergy, both women veered off to the left and right flanks, leaving Brida completely unhindered in the center lane.
"HE’S ALL YOURS, BRIDA!" Gunnhild shouted with a laugh as she cleared the zone.
"RAHHHHHHHHHHH!" Brida roared at the top of her lungs, unleashing a lot of her mana!
BO-BO-BO-BOOM!
Brida’s blood-red crimson aura erupted into a blinding pillar of light with her speed increasing as she leaned her body flat behind her Steel Aegis shield.
Two hundred yards ahead of her—
Hog stood his ground like a mountain rooted into the center of the earth.
He slammed the three-hundred-pound base of his dark-iron Tower Shield deep into the solid bedrock.
CRACK!
Hog lowered his hips, his boots digging three feet deep into the soil.
Elm’s ten-fold stat multiplier surged through Hog’s blood vessels...
His already massive muscles expanded violently, bulging to twice their normal size as thick black veins popped out across his chest, neck, and arms like writhing snakes.
His physical durability and knockback resistance skyrocketed by nine hundred percent...
Combined with Elm’s divine four-leaf magic, Hog was quite literally an Unmovable Wall incarnate.
And charging straight toward him at high speeds was Brida... an Unstoppable Object!
And what happened when an Unstoppable Object met an Unmovable Wall?
There was no complex exchange of technique and there was no intricate display of magic.
There was really only one sound...
BOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOM!
An earth-shattering explosion erupted in the center of the battlefield.
The incomprehensible kinetic force generated by the collision was so immense that a three-hundred-yard shockwave of compressed air and shattered stone blasted outward in every direction.

The physical air pressure was so violent that several hovering streaming drones in the upper atmosphere were destabilized with their optical lenses shaking wildly as they struggled to maintain their video signals.
A massive blinding cloud of dark dust, pulverized rock, and white smoke completely enveloped the collision zone.
On the global stream, over five hundred million viewers held their collective breath, staring at the opaque smoke screen in suspense.
Slowly... the thick dust began to clear in the wind.
Inside the crater—
The Unmovable Wall had not moved a single inch.
Hog stood rooted in the dirt, his iron Tower Shield still planted deep in the bedrock and his heavy boots locked in place.
And the Unstoppable Object... had stopped moving completely.
Brida’s eyes widened slightly beneath her helmet.
For the first time since the war had started, her forward charge had been brought to a dead halt.
SWISH!
Brida immediately pushed off her forward stance, leaping backward fifteen yards through the air with her boots touching down lightly on the grass.
She casually adjusted her grip on the heavy handle of her axe, resting the double-bitted battleaxe against her shoulder as she looked at the jacked man through her visor.
"Hoh..." Brida chuckled, her voice carrying genuine surprised respect. "You’re pretty strong for a standard guy. I want to hear your name!"
Hog raised his head from behind his Tower Shield, his face covered in sweat and dust.
His chest heaved heavily as he gave Brida a skeptical disbelieving eye raise.𝘧𝘳𝘦ℯ𝓌𝘦𝒷𝘯𝑜𝑣𝘦𝓁.𝒸𝘰𝓂
"Hog," the man grumbled bluntly, his voice deep and rough. "Troop Commander of The Unmovable Wall."
Brida offered a broad grin, slapping her palm against her chest plate.
"I am Brida! Garrison Commander and Grand Titan Bastion of the Blessed Land!"
Brida raised her hand, pointing the gleaming edge of her Titan’s Cleaver straight toward Lord Sky’s command vehicle standing five hundred yards in the distance.
She looked back at Hog, her eyes narrowing into sharp slits, as she made a slow deliberate slitting expression across her neck with her thumb.
"You better come at me with everything you’ve got, Hog... or else I’m going to march right past you and kill your Lord."
BOOM!
Hog’s white eyes dilated in bloodthirsty fury.
The threat against his master ignited every single drop of loyalty in his chest.
"YOU CAN THREATEN ME ALL YOU WANT!" Hog roared out with his voice echoing across the basin like thunder. "BUT YOU WILL NEVER THREATEN MY LORD!"
CRACK!
Hog exploded forward out of his defensive trench.
He abandoned his heavy Tower Shield, utilizing his Elm-buffed 10x speed to close the fifteen-yard gap in seconds.
He pivoted his hips, channeling every single ounce of his physical momentum, muscle density, and rage into a devastating high-speed roundhouse kick straight toward Brida’s head.
BOOOOOOM!
Hog’s heavy, iron-shod boot collided squarely with the side of Brida’s face.
A violent shockwave of compressed wind exploded from the point of impact, blowing away the surrounding dirt and grass for twenty yards in every direction.
...However...
Brida’s face barely moved.
In fact... it didn’t move at all.

chapters.title: Chapter 309: Secret Technique [Bonus - ]
paragraphs: Her neck didn’t bend and her head didn’t tilt.
Her boots didn’t slide backward a single millimeter through the dirt either.
She stood there completely stationary, taking the full 10x-buffed roundhouse kick directly to her cheek as if a soft feather had gently brushed against her skin.
Silence settled over the crater.
Hog’s iron boot remained pressed against Brida’s cheek with his leg muscles trembling from the density of her physical form.
Slowly, Brida turned her head, looking at Hog’s trembling leg with an expression that had turned completely uninterested.
Her eyes lost their fiery excitement, replaced by a dull disappointed blankness.
Brida let out a soft bored sigh, adjusting her axe on her shoulder as she spoke in a flat casual tone.𝗳𝐫𝚎𝗲𝚠𝚎𝗯𝕟𝐨𝘃𝚎𝗹.𝗰𝗼𝗺
"You know... my Lord taught me something interesting before we stepped onto this field today. He told me that there are Newbie Lords... and there are Classic Lords."
Brida blinked her red eyes blankly, looking directly into Hog’s horrified face.
"My Lord is a Newbie Lord..." Brida continued casually, "...while your Lord Sky is a Classic Lord, which means your territory has been in the game far longer than ours."
Brida’s red eyes thinned slightly with her expression turning terrifyingly cold as she asked a blunt deadpan question.
"So tell me, Hog... why are your kicks so damn weak?"
Hog froze, his breath catching in his throat.
"Were you holding back just now?" Brida asked. "Because you better not be holding back on me... or I’m going to cave your brains in right here."
Hog stood on the dirt, his leg still pressed against her unyielding cheek, as cold paralyzing terror seized his entire soul.
’Holding back...?’ Hog thought, his mind screaming in incomprehensible horror as sweat drenched his back. ’Holding what back?!’
He had kicked her with literally everything he possessed...
He had used his 10x stat buff, his full physical momentum, his maximum muscle output, and every drop of his rage...
It was a strike powerful enough to probably shatter a stone fortress wall.
...And she hadn’t even felt it?
Brida let out a deep boisterous laugh that echoed across the cratered battlefield like the ringing of a giant brass anvil.
She casually reached up with her broad gloved hand, wiping a smudge of dirt from her cheek right where Hog’s 10x-buffed steel-shod boot had struck her just a second prior.
She didn’t have a single scratch on her skin.
Her visor gleamed under the morning sun with her red eyes burning with a wild infectious thrill for battle.
"Gwahahaha!" Brida chuckled, rolling her broad shoulders as her iron boots shifted in the damp soil. "Not bad, big guy! Now... let’s have a true battle, Hog!"
Standing ten paces away, Hog felt the blood in his veins freeze into solid ice.
He stared at the six-foot-tall shieldmaiden with his single uninjured eye widened to the size of a saucer with his chest heaving as hot steam vented from his nostrils.
Cold terrifying sweat drenched his back beneath his iron chest plate.

’What in the hell...’ Hog thought, his mind spiraling in horror. ’What on earth did Lord Vespera feed this woman to the point where she can just casually ignore a full-power ten-fold stat-multiplied roundhouse kick directly to her face...’
It defied every single law of physical combat he had learned over a lifetime of fighting in the basin.
Even dragon-kin and armored raid bosses flinched when struck with that kind of concentrated force.
...However, Hog was an experienced squad leader.

He had survived dozens of brutal territory engagements under Lord Sky, and his pride as The Unmovable Wall’s strongest troop refused to let him accept the terrifying reality standing right before him.

’No...’ Hog reasoned frantically in his internal thoughts with his teeth grinding together so hard his jaw muscles throbbed. ’There is no way that hit was completely one-sided! I felt it... When my boot connected with her jaw, a sharp tingly vibration traveled all the way up my right fibula! She definitely felt that pain!’
Hog took a slow deliberate breath, steadying his footing as he stared at Brida’s armored form.

’She’s acting,’ Hog convinced himself with his mind grasping at any logical explanation to keep his morale from completely shattering. ’She knows those floating streaming drones are tracking every single micro-movement... so she’s just putting on a tough unbothered front for the camera stream so she doesn’t embarrass her territory in front of a lot of viewers... She’s holding back her grimace... she has to be!’
Brida didn’t care about the stream metrics, nor did she care about Hog’s desperate internal cope.
She raised her broad hands with her eyes locking onto his broad chest.
"Alright, Hog," Brida announced cheerfully. "I’m moving."
Brida took a single deliberate stride forward.
She didn’t raise her battleaxe and she didn’t draw her shield or anything.
Brida didn’t even cock her fist back for a strike.
...Yet, the exact second her boot touched the dirt, a suffocating bloodthirsty wave of physical Murderous Intent erupted from her body like a physical wall of pressure.
FWOOSH!
The staggering weight of her aura distorted the atmospheric air pressure around Hog!
It felt as if a ten-ton iron slab had suddenly been dropped onto Hog’s shoulders.
His instincts... honed by years of life-or-death battles screamed in pure panic.
SWISH!
Before his brain could even process a logical thought, Hog’s body reacted purely on survival reflex.
He violently threw himself backward, executing a desperate high-speed dodge to the right with his boots scraping two deep trenches through the mud as he landed in a defensive crouch twenty feet away.
"Haah... Haah... Haah..."
He panted heavily with his hands raised and his eyes darting frantically to see where the incoming blow was coming from...
...Only to realize Brida hadn’t thrown a strike at all.
She was simply standing in the exact same spot with her arms hanging casually at her sides, looking at him with a wide disappointed grin.

"Pfft! Hahaha!" Brida taunted, letting out a loud mocking scoff as she tilted her head. "What’s the matter, big guy? Are you scared already? Is this really how men are in this world? Jumping at shadows before a fist is even thrown?"
Behind her visor, Brida’s thoughts took a quiet deeply appreciative turn.

’Hah...’ Brida thought inwardly, an affectionate warmth touching her heart as a image of her Lord flashed through her mind. ’I am so bloody glad that the only man I ever have to belong to is my Lord Silas. If I had to deal with skittish, weak-willed men like this every day, I’d have lost my mind weeks ago...’
Brida reached up to her chest plate, unbuckling the heavy leather straps securing her outer adamantine pauldrons.
CLANK!
She unceremoniously tossed the heavy iron pauldrons onto the grass.
She unfastened her armguards, her leg greaves, and finally reached up to the iron clasps at her neck, lifting her heavy helm completely off her head.
THUD!
She threw her helmet to the side, letting it crash into the dirt.
As the heavy steel helmet came off, a long cascading waterfall of luscious black hair tumbled down over her broad shoulders.
Her radiant sun-kissed skin, high cheekbones, and striking piercing eyes were revealed to the open air for the very first time on the global broadcast.
She was drop-dead breathtakingly gorgeous... a wild valkyrie-like beauty that radiated both terrifying physical power and undeniable feminine charm.
Far across the field, on the floating golden screens in Rhyx City, and across over five hundred million mobile displays worldwide, the entire live chat completely stalled.
Viewers, nobles, and rival Lords stared at the screen in disbelief.

It was almost physically impossible to reconcile the fact that this stunning black-haired goddess was the exact same bloodthirsty monster who had spent the last twenty minutes boisterously laughing while pulverizing heavy armored guards into ragdolls.
Hog stood frozen on the grass with a single eye widening as he stared at her bare face.
"You..." Hog choked out, his throat dry.
Brida rolled her neck, her hair swaying behind her back as she stretched her arms.
She looked down at her massive rune-etched axe and her towering Steel Aegis shield lying on the grass beside her.
"Weapon-on-weapon combat is fun..." Brida remarked smoothly, cracking her knuckles with loud cracks. "...but weapons get in the way when you want to feel the raw weight of a good brawl."
Without a single hint of hesitation, Brida kicked her battleaxe and shield thirty feet away into the mud, completely disarming herself.
Hog stared at her discarded weapons, then looked down at his own arms.

He knew that if he kept his eight-foot iron Tower Shield and his broadsword, this terrifying woman might interpret it as a lack of respect or a cowardly crutch... and in her current mood, acting out of petty arrogance might cause her to snap and tear his head clean off his shoulders.
THUD! CLANG!
Hog unbuckled his iron Tower Shield, letting the eight-hundred-pound slab of metal crash flat into the soil.
He unsheathed his heavy broadsword, throwing it into the dirt beside his shield, and even reached into his belt straps to unholster two hidden silver-plated combat daggers, tossing them away as well.
Brida watched him strip his gear, nodding approvingly.
She looked down at her lightweight tunic and dark trousers.

’Hmm...’ Brida pondered in her internal thoughts, tugging slightly at the collar of her tunic. ’These clothes are durable, but they’re still a bit heavy for maximum movement speed... Should I just strip down to my sports bra and combat shorts like we do during private training drills back at the Keep?’
She paused, her crimson eyes blinking as a sudden sharp realization hit her mind.

’Wait, no!’ Brida corrected herself rapidly, a slight adorable flush touching her cheeks as she shook her head. ’Absolutely not! My body in a sports bra is private property reserved exclusively for my Lord Silas’s eyes and the rest of the girls! I’m not letting random degenerates on a magic mirror watch me walk around in my undergarments...’
Brida cleared her throat, shaking off the thought, and dropped her hips into a wide perfectly balanced martial arts stance.
She raised both of her bare calloused fists in front of her chest with her eyes locking onto Hog with uncompromising intensity.
"Alright, Hog!" Brida barked out, her voice echoing across the basin. "Come after me with everything you’ve got! Maximum physical output! No holding back!"
Hog gritted his teeth, his jaw setting into a desperate line.
He looked down at his bare, muscular forearms. Deep within his chest, a dark dangerous resolve ignited in his core.

’I didn’t want to resort to this...’ Hog thought, his inner voice trembling with lethal determination. ’It permanently damages the muscle fibers... it takes months of healing to recover from... but if I don’t use it right now, I won’t just lose... I’ll die.’
HUMMMMMMM!
Suddenly, the red aura surrounding Hog’s body underwent a terrifying, volatile mutation.

The bright crimson energy deepened into a dark blood-maroon hue as thick, superheated white steam and pressurized gas erupted from the pores of his skin, venting out into the air with loud whistling shrieks.
HISSSSSSS!
As the burning steam vented outward, Hog’s massive six-foot-eight frame underwent a visible shocking physical transformation.
His bulged, mountain-like muscles didn’t expand... instead, they rapidly compressed and slimmed down, burning away surface bulk to condense his muscle fibers into a wiry and adamantine state.
Brida tilted her head, her golden eyebrows raising in genuine curiosity as she observed the steam venting from his chest.
"Oho?" Brida enquired smoothly, watching his physical frame shrink into a streamlined wiry build. "What kind of strange technique is that? You’re burning off your own physical mass?"
Before Brida could even finish her enquiry—
BOOM!
Hog didn’t answer.
Utilizing the explosive transformation, Hog vanished from his position.
He executed a forward dash that was easily five times faster than any movement he had displayed previously.
SWISH!

He materialized directly in front of Brida’s face in perhaps a second as he pivoted his hips, channeling his condensed mass into a ruthless high-velocity straight right punch aimed straight between her eyes.
BAM!
The iron fist struck Brida squarely on the bridge of her nose and the impact generated a sharp violent shockwave.
...And for the first time in the entire battle, Brida’s head tilted back slightly, and her boots took a single, clear step backward through the dirt.
STEP!
Hog’s single eye flared with an ecstatic light as he felt her body shift backward.
’IT WORKED!’ Hog roared in his internal thoughts with his heart hammering against his ribs like a war drum! ’My Family Secret Technique!’
