Vespera focused her mental awareness, attempting to trigger the perception phase.

In theory, the atmospheric water moisture was supposed to read Morrighan’s micro-telegraphs... muscle tension, breath control, weight distribution and highlight glowing blue current lines pointing straight to Morrighan’s open gaps.
...However, just as Morwenna had warned during their earlier training sessions, the Second Style was insanely difficult to master.
Vespera’s vision didn’t flood with clear, glowing blue lines.
The atmospheric moisture read the dark brimstone heat radiating off Morrighan’s demonic aura, creating distorted, flickering blue wisps that faded in and out of sight.
Vespera couldn’t get a clear, stable read on the opening.
’Fucking hell...’ Vespera thought with a sigh. ’The heat from her demonic mana is warping the moisture pressure...
I can’t rely on full perception.’
BOOM!
Morrighan arrived directly in front of her!
"BRIMSTONE PUNCH!" Morrighan yelled out, driving her heavy spiked mythril gauntlet straight for Vespera’s chest.
The fist was wrapped in a roaring vortex of dark brimstone flames.
Vespera couldn’t read the complete flaw, but her raw combat instincts and gold-core reaction speed kicked in.
CLANG!
Vespera raised her single steel longsword horizontally, catching Morrighan’s massive spiked gauntlet right against the flat of her blade.
KABAGHHH!
The physical impact of Morrighan’s boosted demonic strength was immense.
The shockwave blasted the grass beneath their boots forty feet into the air, forcing Vespera’s boots to skid backward five feet across the torn mud.
"HAAAAAH!"
Morrighan didn’t stop.
Driven by her fierce desire to prove her worth, she spun her body mid-air, her heavy scale-armored crimson tail whipping around like a steel mace straight toward Vespera’s exposed left flank.
SWISH!
Vespera executed rapid footwork, stepping inside the arc of the tail strike...
She swung her longsword upward, using a basic deflection arc—
CLANG!
The blade struck the scale armor of Morrighan’s tail, sending bright orange sparks showering into the dust.
’Chains...
I need my chains...’
While her tail was still engaged, Morrighan thrust her left palm straight down into the dirt!
CRACK!
CRACK!
CRACK!
Four massive, shadow-forged abyssal chains erupted out of the mud directly beneath Vespera’s boots, coiling around her ankles and pulling tight.
Vespera felt the chilling stamina-draining cold of the abyssal chains locking her legs in place.
’Impulsive... but creative!’ Vespera evaluated internally, her eyes gleaming with genuine admiration. ’She chained a physical distraction straight into a crowd-control spell!’
"BRIMSTONE BOLT!" Morrighan screamed, thrusting both hands forward at point-blank range.
A massive smoky fireball of dark demonic fire shot straight for Vespera’s face.
Vespera didn’t panic.
She didn’t draw on her Tier 3 destructive spells like Fulgur Annihilation or Incineration Ray since she was explicitly keeping this fight strictly focused on her swordsmanship and controlled output.
HUMMMMM!
Vespera channeled her Gold Core wind mana through her single blade, executing a high-speed vertical slash.
VWOOSH!
A crescent of compressed wind pressure exploded from her steel tip, slicing the incoming brimstone fireball cleanly in half.
The two halves of dark fire detonated harmlessly behind Vespera, scorching the distant mud.
CRUNCH!
With a flex of her mana, Vespera shattered the abyssal chains around her ankles, stepping free from the dark links.
Morrighan was panting heavily now as she landed.
"Hah...
Hah..."
The heavy toll of `Demon’s Resolve` was already starting to drain her stamina reserves, but her golden eyes burned with ferocious unyielding spirit.
"AGAIN!" Morrighan bellowed, drawing deep on her lingering reserves.
She rushed forward, throwing a barrage of heavy, gauntleted punches, tail sweeps, and brimstone blasts.
CLANG!
BAM!
CLANG!
VWOOSH!
Vespera retreated step-by-step across the clearing, parrying every strike with her longsword blurring into a silver circle of steel.
Throughout the intense exchange, Vespera continuously maintained the Second Style: Rip-Current Perception.
She cycled ambient moisture through her internal circuits, pushing her mind to filter out the chaotic brimstone heat and read Morrighan’s underlying movement telegraphs.
’I need this to work...’
Ten seconds... twenty seconds... thirty seconds of high-speed clashing passed.
Morrighan’s movements were gradually slowing down.
Her shoulder was dipping half an inch low on every third punch and her breath control was becoming ragged.
And then... for a single, fleeting microsecond...
In Vespera’s heightened perception, the ambient moisture pressure suddenly clicked into place.

A single razor-thin wisp of glowing blue light current materialized in the air... pointing directly to a microscopic opening under Morrighan’s left armpit as she raised her gauntlet for a heavy overhead strike.
’THERE!’ Vespera’s mind screamed.
It wasn’t a full perfect vision of the Second Style... it was barely a slim, brief opening that lasted for a fraction of a second but it was enough.
SWISH!
Vespera executed an instantaneous forward step, slipping cleanly under Morrighan’s raised mythril gauntlet.
She didn’t use the cutting edge of her sword.

Instead, Vespera reversed her grip, driving the flat pommel of her longsword precisely into the open gap under Morrighan’s left rib cage, followed by a swift, gentle tap of her gloved hand against the side of Morrighan’s neck.
THWACK!
The precise impact shut down the nerve cluster along Morrighan’s spine.
The dark cursed magic circles spinning around the clearing instantly shattered into harmless black particles as the crimson aura around Morrighan’s body faded away.
"Ah..." Morrighan let out a soft, airy breath.
Her molten-gold eyes lost their focus with her long crimson hair trailing in the wind as her knees buckled.
As her body tipped forward, falling toward the damp grass, a single cute and flustered thought flashed through Morrighan’s fading consciousness.
’Ah... her hand was so warm...
I am finally... home...’
"My Lord..." Morrighan whispered softly.
THUD.
Morrighan’s tall horned frame landed gently on the mud, completely unconscious, a peaceful contented smile resting on her dark lips.
Vespera lowered her sword, letting out a long, quiet breath as steam rose from her blade.
She looked down at the sleeping demoness, reaching up to adjust her spatial hood as a slight, sheepish look touched her face.
"Ah..." Vespera muttered softly to herself, looking at Morwenna.
"Did I... did I go a little too hard on her?"
Morwenna chuckled dryly from atop her wolf, shaking her head.
"She’s fine, Captain.
Her ribs are intact.
She just needs an hour of sleep."
Vespera looked at her single steel longsword with her thoughts turning back to the slim, flickering wisp of the Second Style she had managed to trigger at the very end.
’I barely caught that opening...’ Vespera thought. ’The Second Style really is a nightmare to master in real-time combat.
I couldn’t push my perception speed as fast as I wanted...
I just need to train a lot more but damn...’
Nobody else was coming to her.
’Are they afraid?’
Meanwhile, far across the central battlefield...
The chaotic clash between the main forces was reaching a terrifying elemental climax.
Ignis... the Flame Hero and Frost... the Glacial Hero were completely terrorizing both sides of the clearing.
Because they were operating as a paired elemental Hero team, their combined mana output was creating immense collateral destruction.

Ignis was hurling fifty-foot fireballs that incinerated defensive barriers, while Frost was casting wide-area blizzards that froze the weapons of both Sky’s infantrymen and Blessed Land’s Vanguard women alike.
They did not care about casualties at all.
"GET BACK!" a Shieldmaiden screamed out, retreating as a wall of blue ice spiked out of the ground.
"HAHAHAHA!" Ignis laughed hysterically, his hands engulfed in white-hot flames as he floated ten feet above the scorched dirt.
"Is this all the famous Blessed Land has to offer?!
You can’t even close the distance through our dual domain!"
Beside him, Frost hovered with cold arrogant detachment with his icy blue eyes scanning the disoriented troops below.
"It’s useless," Frost declared coldly.
"Our anti-gravity rune arrays protect us from ground lockdown, and our combined elemental density cannot be pierced by simple infantry charges!"
Sky’s disoriented troops and Blessed Land’s Vanguard were both being pushed back by the unbridled environmental pressure of fire and ice.
...Suddenly...
HUMMMMMMM!
Directly beneath the floating boots of Ignis and Frost, the damp scorched earth began to glow with a brilliant deep-sapphire light.
A massive intricate Runic magic circle stretching thirty yards wide materialized on the ground, its complex runic geometric lines spinning with terrifying power.
SWISH!
A sleek elegant figure stepped out from behind a frozen rock pillar.
Rowenna calmly walked into the open clearing.
She reached up with her gloved hand, smoothly pulling back her dark hood to reveal her striking features as her long hair fluttered in the wind.
She wasn’t holding any staff as her hands were completely empty, resting casually at her sides.
Ignis and Frost stopped their attacks mid-air, snapping their heads down to glare at the lone Rune Weaver.
"Look who finally stepped out!" Ignis taunted arrogantly with a wide sneer on his face.
"A runic arcanist!
Don’t bother trying to pull us down with spatial tricks, woman!
We carry special High-Tier Anti-Gravity Runes carved directly into our chest armor!
Your basic spells won’t even nudge us—"
Rowenna paused in her tracks.
She looked up at the two hovering Heroes with her sharp eyes completely unbothered as her voice cut cleanly through their taunts with icy authority.
"Yes..." Rowenna interrupted smoothly, a sharp, dangerous grin curving her lips.
"...I know you have anti-gravity runes."
Ignis and Frost froze, their eyes widening in sudden instinctual horror.
KRA-THOOOOOOOOOM!
Before either Hero could react, Rowenna snapped her right fingers.
KABAAAAAM!
The deep-sapphire runic array on the ground violently exploded with twenty times the force of standard atmospheric gravity.
The space above the circle visually distorted, bending light and air inward like a collapsing black hole.
CRASH!
KABAGHHH!
The anti-gravity runes carved into Ignis and Frost’s armor instantly shattered under the astronomical weight of the 20x gravity well.
Both Heroes didn’t just fall... they were forcefully, violently slammed straight down from mid-air into the bedrock like two dropped iron anvils!
BOOOOOOM!
The velocity of their collision smashed a forty-foot crater into the dirt.𝐟𝕣𝗲𝕖𝕨𝗲𝐛𝗻𝗼𝐯𝗲𝚕.𝗰𝚘𝐦

Bedrock shattered into fine powder as Ignis and Frost were pinned flat on their bellies in the dirt, the overwhelming 20x gravity pressing down on their spines so hard they couldn’t even lift a single finger or vent a breath of fire.
Rowenna stood at the edge of the crater, looking down at the two trapped Heroes with a calm predatory smirk on her face.
She dusted off her sleeves, her voice echoing coldly across the silent battlefield.
"I’ve been listening..." Rowenna finished smoothly.
"...from the very beginning."

chapters.title: Chapter 318: Rowenna’s Confidence
paragraphs: The forty-foot crater in the center of the Umbral Basin groaned under the invisible suffocating weight of twenty times atmospheric gravity.
The battlefield was no longer just dirt and stone.
The terrifying downforce had compressed the bedrock into a smooth darkened sheet of hyper-dense glass.
Every loose pebble, every stray blade of grass, and every droplet of moisture had been violently flattened against the earth.
The air itself was warping as the deep sapphire magic circle etched into the floor of the crater pulsed in steady cycles, bending the surrounding light inward like a localized spatial sinkhole.
"U-ugh!"
In the center of that crushed zone, Ignis and Frost lay pinned flat against the stone.
The physical pressure was incomprehensible.
It was as if a mountain range had been condensed into a sheet of iron and dropped directly onto their spines.
Their heavy armor plates, forged to withstand the brutal impacts of high-tier magical beasts, were failing.
The steel gauntlets covering their hands scraped uselessly against the ground, grinding into fine stone powder as they tried to find even a millimeter of leverage.
Rowenna stood gracefully at the northern lip of the crater.
Her long silky hair, which had grown significantly longer and more lustrous following her evolution to an S-Rank Grand Runemaster, cascaded past her shoulder in dark waves.
The updrafts generated by the battlefield fires tugged lightly at her pristine robes and beneath the high-quality fabric, her newly sculpted hourglass figure stood relaxed.
Her sharp blue eyes looked down at the two trapped Heroes with a sense of cold detachment.
"Is this truly the limit of Sky’s vanguard?" Rowenna murmured softly.
Her voice was cool and smooth, carrying effortlessly over the whistling wind of the battlefield.
She didn’t sound angry or triumphant. Rowenna sounded genuinely disappointed.
"I expected at least a minor challenge," Rowenna continued, delicately dusting an imaginary speck of ash from her sleeve. "Especially after I spent so much time refining my deconstructions."
Down in the crushed bedrock, Ignis’s teeth gritted together with such feral intensity that a faint cracking sound echoed inside his scorched helmet.
Blood welled up from his gums.
The sheer gravitational weight was compressing his internal organs, forcing the dark crimson liquid to drip past his lips and splatter onto the flat stone beneath his visor.
Yet, his mana core refused to submit.
It flared inside his chest with wild desperate defiance, pumping raw heat through his agonizing veins.
"Shut... up..." Ignis spat.
His voice was thick with blood and distortion, grinding out from his throat like crushed gravel.
He forced his neck upward, defying the crushing atmospheric downforce through pure willpower.
"Do you think..." Ignis snarled with his bloodshot eyes burning beneath his visor. "...a single gravity array... is enough to put down the Flame Warden of the Unmovable Wall?!"
Beside him, Frost was fairing no better.
His icy blue eyes burned with cold panicked resolve.
He couldn’t lift his torso. Every breath he drew felt like dragging jagged, broken glass through his lungs under the weight of twenty atmospheres.
Yet, his left hand twitched.
Through agonizing physical effort, Frost managed to slide his frost-covered gauntlet barely three inches across the crushed stone, bringing it agonizingly close to Ignis’s scorched pauldrons.
"Ignis..." Frost choked out.
His breath froze the ambient moisture instantly, coating the mud beneath his chin in a layer of dark blue ice.
"Thermal Overdrive," Frost whispered, his voice laced with finality. "Now."
"Do it!" Ignis roared, spit and blood flying from his lips.
The dual elemental Wardens did not attempt to fight the twenty-times downforce with physical muscle.
They were veterans of countless wars under Sky’s banner, and they understood that raw physical strength meant nothing against spatial manipulation.
Instead, they tapped directly into the deepest, most dangerous secret of their paired synergy.
It was a technique, forged through years of fighting side-by-side on the bloody frontlines of the Sovereign Realm.
Ignis forced his left gauntlet flat against Frost’s shoulder plate.
Simultaneously, Frost clamped his frost-covered fingers onto Ignis’s arm.
A violent apocalyptic thermal reaction detonated between their bodies.
Ignis channeled every single drop of his superheated, white-hot flame mana directly into Frost’s body.
At the exact same microsecond, Frost flooded Ignis’s core with absolute-zero glacial energy.
The collision of these two opposing elemental extremes at point-blank range did not result in a simple neutralization.
In the high-tier physics of the Sovereign Realm, introducing sudden, temperature shifts into a compressed space created a rapid, explosive molecular expansion.
KABOOOOOOOM!
A massive shockwave of superheated steam, thermal displacement, and pure pressure erupted from the center of the crater!
The sudden, violent expanding force generated tens of thousands of pounds of upward pressure in a fraction of a second.
The thermal explosion completely overwhelmed the downward vector of Rowenna’s gravity well.
’Oh that’s actually very smart...’
CRACK! CRACK! SHATTER!
The deep purple runic circle etched into the bedrock shattered like brittle glass.
The complex geometric lines fractured into thousands of glowing magic particles, instantly dissolving into the burning chaotic air.
Ignis and Frost shot straight up out of the crater like two elemental meteors.
They flipped mid-air, tearing through the thick cloud of boiling steam generated by their own explosion.
They soared over the lip of the crater, crashing heavily onto the scorched grass thirty yards away.
Their heavy boots dug deep, ten-foot trenches into the mud as they skidded to a halt.
"Haah... We managed..."
"Damn... right guh!"
They were panting heavily.
Blood leaked from their broken armor seals, and their bodies were bruised and battered from the immense gravitational crushing they had just endured.
However, their combined elemental aura erupted to heights three times greater than before.
The near-death experience had pushed their cores into overdrive.
Ignis threw his head back and spat a thick wad of dark blood onto the ground.
A wild sneer spread across his face as white-hot plasma fire engulfed both of his arms, raging all the way up to his shoulders.
The air around him began to warp and distort from the sheer volume of heat.
"HAHAHAHA!" Ignis laughed hysterically.
His voice echoed over the battlefield with a mad feral thrill. He pointed a burning finger toward the crater.

"Did you see that, Arcanist?!" Ignis screamed, his eyes wide with adrenaline. "You thought you could lock us down with a simple spatial trick?! Our synergy bypasses basic physics! You cannot hold the storm!"
Frost stood right beside him with his posture rigid and unyielding.
His ice-covered armor hummed with a terrifying frequency.
Jagged, sub-zero crystalline spears materialized out of thin air, hovering around his waist like floating daggers spinning with lethal velocity.

"You got arrogant, woman," Frost said coldly, wiping a stream of half-frozen blood from his cheek with the back of his gauntlet. "You relied on your power and thought we were common soldiers. You gave us time to sync our cores. Now, the battlefield belongs to us!"
The collateral force of their thermal release had completely transformed the surrounding environment.
For a hundred yards in every direction, the green grass instantly flash-froze into jagged, dark blue glaciers.
Seconds later, massive geysers of roaring crimson fire erupted from the subterranean fissures beneath the ice.
’They’re really strong...’
The magma geysers shattered the glaciers into floating, burning ice shards.

The sky above them turned into a swirling chaotic vortex of gray ash, boiling steam, and freezing rain as the entire central clearing of the Umbral Basin had been turned into a literal hellscape of dual elemental destruction.
The winds howled across the basin.
The conflicting pressures of extreme heat and cold bent trees in half, snapping trunks like twigs and sending scorched mud soaring across the frontlines.
Seeing the two Heroes break free and unleash such widespread, catastrophic environmental havoc, two nearby members of Blessed Land’s Vanguard immediately pivoted away from their skirmishes.
Fenna, still carrying the unconscious form of Lupina over her shoulder, skidded to a halt atop a tall stone ridge overlooking the chaos.
Without a moment of hesitation, Fenna’s composite bow was instantly drawn to her ear.
A glowing armor-piercing arrow materialized on the string, aimed straight down through the thermal currents, locked directly onto Ignis’s chest plate.
Her eagle-sharp hazel eyes calculated the trajectory through the chaotic wind in a split second.
She adjusted for the thermal updraft with her breathing perfectly slow and steady despite the roaring inferno below.
Beside the ridge, Gunnhild slammed her massive iron tower shield into the cracked earth with a resonating thud.
Her red eyes burned with eager combat lust.
She gripped the leather hilt of her broadsword with her muscular frame tensing as she prepared to dive straight into the elemental storm.
"Hey! Rowenna!" Gunnhild bellowed over the roaring winds.
Her loud boisterous voice carried across the clearing like a warhorn, cutting through the sound of shattering ice.

"Stop playing around with those two elemental freaks!" Gunnhild yelled, pointing her broadsword toward the geysers. "Fenna and I will flank them from the left! I’ll take the fire idiot’s charge straight to my shield! You just lock the ice guy back down before he freezes the whole damn supply line!"
Up on the ridge, Fenna’s eyes narrowed as her fingers held the bowstring taut.
"I have a clear line on the freezing one’s right shoulder joint," Fenna announced. "One shot will sever his internal mana circulation. Give the order, Rowenna."
Down in the center of the storm, Rowenna didn’t turn her head.
She didn’t flinch from the roaring heat waves washing over her long lustrous hair.
She stood with her arms resting peacefully at her sides, framed against the backdrop of roaring fire and jagged frost like a queen standing in her private garden.
Rowenna simply raised her right hand, casually waving her gloved fingers in a dismissive stay-back motion toward her Vanguard sisters.
"Focus on clearing Sky’s remaining heavy infantry units along the western tree line, Gunnhild." Rowenna instructed.
Her voice was completely calm and confident, if Gunnhild didn’t see her face, it would have been hard to say that this was Rowenna at all.
"Fenna, continue moving Lupina to the medical tent at the rear," Rowenna added smoothly. "I do not require assistance here."
Rowenna paused.
Her deep blue eyes tilted toward the two glowing elemental Heroes, and a small razor-sharp smirk curved her lips.
"I am going to handle these two... completely alone."
Gunnhild blinked in surprise, her broadsword lowering a fraction of an inch.
Then, she threw her head back and let out a loud, boisterous laugh that shook her armored shoulders.

"BAHAHAHA!" Gunnhild cheered, pulling her heavy iron shield out of the dirt with ease. "Look at you, showing off just because you got that shiny new upgrade! Fine, fine! Have your fun, Rowenna! But if you leave a single drop of liquor in Sky’s command tents after blowing them up, I’m taking it all for myself!"
Up on the ridge, Fenna gave a concise respectful nod.
"Understood," Fenna said quietly. "Do not let them burn the western forest. The monsters..."
With a swift, silent jump, Fenna vanished into the shadows with Lupina over her shoulder.
Gunnhild turned with a wild grin, charging back into the main melee line, her broadsword already swinging toward a clustered formation of Sky’s heavy guards with reckless enthusiasm.
Standing entirely alone against the dual elemental storm, Rowenna finally decided to take the engagement seriously.
She reached her right hand out into the empty air beside her.
HUMMMMM!
A vertical tear in space materialized perfectly beside her shoulder.
The rift glowed with brilliant, pulsating sapphire light, radiating an aura of intense arcane pressure that instantly stabilized the chaotic winds around her body.
Rowenna reached her slender fingers gracefully into the spatial rift.
Her hand clamped around the polished, heavy metal shaft of her primary weapon.
She smoothly pulled out The Sapphire-Core World Weaver.
It was a magnificent staff forged of high-density Tier 3 mythril alloy, covered in microscopic runic engravings that detailed the fundamental laws of gravity and space.
Capping the top of the staff was a massive pristine blue sapphire core that radiated pure unrefined power.
The moment the World Weaver fully entered the atmosphere, Rowenna’s S-Rank mana core flared to life.
A massive visible deep-blue shockwave of pure mana rippled outward from her boots.
The density of her aura flattened the rising flames for fifty yards and blew the thick suffocating ash entirely out of the clearing.
"Alone?!" Ignis roared, his blood boiling at her dismissive attitude and casual display of power.
His pride as a Warden was shattered... He refused to be looked down upon by a backline caster.
"You damn arrogant bitch!" Ignis screamed, his white-hot plasma arms flaring wildly. "WE ARE THE DUAL ELEMENTAL WARDENS!"
Ignis and Frost attacked simultaneously, their movements syncing with terrifying seamless coordination born from years of shared bloodshed.
"INFERNO DRAGON!" Ignis bellowed from the bottom of his lungs.
He thrust both of his hands forward and a massive, two-hundred-foot long dragon of pure white-hot plasma fire erupted from his palms.

Seconds later, massive geysers of roaring crimson fire erupted from the subterranean fissures beneath the ice.
’They’re really strong...’
The magma geysers shattered the glaciers into floating, burning ice shards.

The sky above them turned into a swirling chaotic vortex of gray ash, boiling steam, and freezing rain as the entire central clearing of the Umbral Basin had been turned into a literal hellscape of dual elemental destruction.
The winds howled across the basin.
The conflicting pressures of extreme heat and cold bent trees in half, snapping trunks like twigs and sending scorched mud soaring across the frontlines.
Seeing the two Heroes break free and unleash such widespread, catastrophic environmental havoc, two nearby members of Blessed Land’s Vanguard immediately pivoted away from their skirmishes.
Fenna, still carrying the unconscious form of Lupina over her shoulder, skidded to a halt atop a tall stone ridge overlooking the chaos.
Without a moment of hesitation, Fenna’s composite bow was instantly drawn to her ear.
A glowing armor-piercing arrow materialized on the string, aimed straight down through the thermal currents, locked directly onto Ignis’s chest plate.
Her eagle-sharp hazel eyes calculated the trajectory through the chaotic wind in a split second.
She adjusted for the thermal updraft with her breathing perfectly slow and steady despite the roaring inferno below.
Beside the ridge, Gunnhild slammed her massive iron tower shield into the cracked earth with a resonating thud.
Her red eyes burned with eager combat lust.
She gripped the leather hilt of her broadsword with her muscular frame tensing as she prepared to dive straight into the elemental storm.
"Hey!
Rowenna!" Gunnhild bellowed over the roaring winds.
Her loud boisterous voice carried across the clearing like a warhorn, cutting through the sound of shattering ice.
"Stop playing around with those two elemental freaks!" Gunnhild yelled, pointing her broadsword toward the geysers.
"Fenna and I will flank them from the left!
I’ll take the fire idiot’s charge straight to my shield!
You just lock the ice guy back down before he freezes the whole damn supply line!"
Up on the ridge, Fenna’s eyes narrowed as her fingers held the bowstring taut.
"I have a clear line on the freezing one’s right shoulder joint," Fenna announced.
"One shot will sever his internal mana circulation.
Give the order, Rowenna."
Down in the center of the storm, Rowenna didn’t turn her head.
She didn’t flinch from the roaring heat waves washing over her long lustrous hair.
She stood with her arms resting peacefully at her sides, framed against the backdrop of roaring fire and jagged frost like a queen standing in her private garden.
Rowenna simply raised her right hand, casually waving her gloved fingers in a dismissive stay-back motion toward her Vanguard sisters.
"Focus on clearing Sky’s remaining heavy infantry units along the western tree line, Gunnhild." Rowenna instructed.
Her voice was completely calm and confident, if Gunnhild didn’t see her face, it would have been hard to say that this was Rowenna at all.
"Fenna, continue moving Lupina to the medical tent at the rear," Rowenna added smoothly.
"I do not require assistance here."
Rowenna paused.
Her deep blue eyes tilted toward the two glowing elemental Heroes, and a small razor-sharp smirk curved her lips.
"I am going to handle these two... completely alone."
Gunnhild blinked in surprise, her broadsword lowering a fraction of an inch.
Then, she threw her head back and let out a loud, boisterous laugh that shook her armored shoulders.
"BAHAHAHA!" Gunnhild cheered, pulling her heavy iron shield out of the dirt with ease.
"Look at you, showing off just because you got that shiny new upgrade!
Fine, fine!
Have your fun, Rowenna!
But if you leave a single drop of liquor in Sky’s command tents after blowing them up, I’m taking it all for myself!"
Up on the ridge, Fenna gave a concise respectful nod.
"Understood," Fenna said quietly.
"Do not let them burn the western forest.
The monsters..."
With a swift, silent jump, Fenna vanished into the shadows with Lupina over her shoulder.
Gunnhild turned with a wild grin, charging back into the main melee line, her broadsword already swinging toward a clustered formation of Sky’s heavy guards with reckless enthusiasm.
Standing entirely alone against the dual elemental storm, Rowenna finally decided to take the engagement seriously.
She reached her right hand out into the empty air beside her.
HUMMMMM!
A vertical tear in space materialized perfectly beside her shoulder.
The rift glowed with brilliant, pulsating sapphire light, radiating an aura of intense arcane pressure that instantly stabilized the chaotic winds around her body.
Rowenna reached her slender fingers gracefully into the spatial rift.
Her hand clamped around the polished, heavy metal shaft of her primary weapon.
She smoothly pulled out The Sapphire-Core World Weaver.
It was a magnificent staff forged of high-density Tier 3 mythril alloy, covered in microscopic runic engravings that detailed the fundamental laws of gravity and space.
Capping the top of the staff was a massive pristine blue sapphire core that radiated pure unrefined power.
The moment the World Weaver fully entered the atmosphere, Rowenna’s S-Rank mana core flared to life.
A massive visible deep-blue shockwave of pure mana rippled outward from her boots.
The density of her aura flattened the rising flames for fifty yards and blew the thick suffocating ash entirely out of the clearing.
"Alone?!" Ignis roared, his blood boiling at her dismissive attitude and casual display of power.
His pride as a Warden was shattered...
He refused to be looked down upon by a backline caster.
"You damn arrogant bitch!" Ignis screamed, his white-hot plasma arms flaring wildly.
"WE ARE THE DUAL ELEMENTAL WARDENS!"
Ignis and Frost attacked simultaneously, their movements syncing with terrifying seamless coordination born from years of shared bloodshed.
"INFERNO DRAGON!" Ignis bellowed from the bottom of his lungs.
He thrust both of his hands forward and a massive, two-hundred-foot long dragon of pure white-hot plasma fire erupted from his palms.

chapters.title: Chapter 319: Clash Of Titans
paragraphs: The elemental beast was so intensely hot that it incinerated the oxygen in the air with its massive jaw snapping open as it melted the stone floor beneath it into a glowing river of liquid glass.
"GLACIAL AVALANCHE!" Frost screamed in perfect unison.
Frost leaped thirty feet into the storm clouds above the fire dragon.
He slammed his hands downward, summoning a massive unnatural rain of three-hundred razor-sharp, sub-zero ice spears.
The projectiles plunged down from the sky like a falling weaponized glacier with each spear dense enough to pierce solid adamantine.
The two attacks did not clash... they intertwined.
Mid-air, the fire dragon coiled around the falling ice spears, forming an apocalyptic, rotating drill of roaring plasma and freezing steel-ice.
The combined elemental mass tore through the basin at high speed.
The ground beneath the strike was completely obliterated.
Liquid lava flowed on the bottom, while solid dark blue ice formed on the top, creating a terrifying unstoppable wave of pure destruction aimed straight for Rowenna’s chest.
’This is the difference between our regular opponents and experienced ones...’
The air pressure alone threatened to crush anything standing in its path.
The sound was deafening, a continuous roaring thunder as elemental energy tore reality open.
Rowenna didn’t take a single step backward, hell she didn’t even flinch.𝘧𝓇ℯℯ𝑤ℯ𝘣𝓃ℴ𝓋𝑒𝑙.𝑐𝘰𝑚
She gripped the World Weaver staff in her right hand, her blue eyes reflecting the incoming plasma drill.
She lightly tapped the mythril butt-end of the staff against the bedrock.
TAP!
’Omni-Elemental Runic Array!’
In less than a hundredth of a second, four massive, multi-colored geometric magic circles materialized perfectly in the air around Rowenna’s body.
She didn’t vocalize a single chant and she didn’t weave complex hand signs.
The authority of her S-Rank class brought the high-tier runes into existence instantly.
’Glacial Rune!’
Rowenna swept her staff upward in a single graceful arc.
A towering, sixty-foot wall of dense absolute-zero sapphire ice erupted from the earth directly in front of the advancing fire dragon.
KRA-THOOOOOM!
The two-hundred-foot flame dragon slammed straight into Rowenna’s sapphire ice wall with a sky-rending explosion.
Millions of gallons of superheated steam detonated into the air instantly, obscuring the entire northern quadrant of the battlefield in a thick blinding white fog.
The shockwave rattled the bones of infantrymen a long distance away.
Before the steam could even disperse, Frost’s avalanche of three-hundred glacial spears plunged down through the clouds, aiming to impale Rowenna from above while her vision was blocked.
Rowenna didn’t even look up at the sky.
She casually raised her left, unarmored palm toward the descending clouds.
’Kinetic Repulsion Field!’
An invisible violent wave of reversed gravitational force exploded upward from Rowenna’s extended palm.
CRASH! SHATTER!
The three-hundred sub-zero ice spears hit the invisible repulsion field exactly thirty feet above Rowenna’s head.
The immense downforce of the spears met the upward vector of her gravity manipulation.
Every single ice spear instantly shattered into fine, glittering snow powder, blown straight back up into the storm clouds like a reverse blizzard.
"BEHIND YOU!" Ignis screamed from inside the blinding steam.
It was a trap.
Using the thick fog and Frost’s overhead attack as a dual cover, Ignis had executed a high-speed dash.
He bypassed the ice wall entirely, appearing directly behind Rowenna’s unprotected back.
His gauntlets were no longer simply burning.
He had condensed his flame mana into two razor-thin, white-hot plasma blades specifically designed to slice through scales and defensive spells that were even of a high tier.
"DIE, YOU BITCH!" Ignis yelled.
He thrust both plasma blades straight for Rowenna’s spine, aiming to sever her spinal cord and instantly end the fight.
Rowenna’s deep blue eyes flashed with cold dangerous light.
’Ultra Runic Disruption!’
The fifty-meter passive aura radiating from Rowenna’s core, which had been passively analyzing the battlefield, flared to its maximum density.
The exact second Ignis stepped within three feet of Rowenna’s back, the complex internal mana equations sustaining his plasma blades violently destabilized.
The aura acted like a magical virus, forcibly hacking the structure of his spell.
The fire magic backfired catastrophically inside his own palms.
KABOOM!
The plasma blades exploded directly in Ignis’s face.
The blast shattered his visor, scorched his skin, and launched him backward across the dirt like a discarded ragdoll.
"AAAGGGHH! MY EYES!" Ignis shrieked in agony.
He rolled across the mud, clutching his bleeding face as smoke poured from his ruined helmet.
However, Ignis’s failure was merely the second layer of the trap.
While Rowenna was dealing with Ignis’s surprise rear assault, Frost seized the momentary window of distraction.
Frost burst out from the frozen mud to her left, his core burning with every drop of his remaining mana.
He didn’t use a massive area spell that would trigger her repulsion fields.
’That would be stupid so...’
Instead, he compressed his absolute-zero ice into a microscopic high-speed Glacial Needle designed specifically for silent rapid armor penetration.
SWISH!
The razor-thin needle of ice bypassed Rowenna’s outer aura.
It pierced straight through the delicate fabric of her left shoulder robe and grazed her pale skin.
A thin line of crimson blood surfaced on Rowenna’s shoulder as the freezing frost instantly spread across her skin, chilling the tissue and attempting to invade her bloodstream.
Frost landed fifteen feet away.
He was panting heavily with blood running freely down his chin, but a triumphant manic laugh burst from his exhausted chest.
"HA! HAHAHA! I HIT HER!" Frost screamed to the blinded Ignis.
He pointed a shaking gauntlet at Rowenna’s shoulder.
"I pierced her defense!" Frost celebrated wildly. "The absolute-zero frost is invading her bloodstream! Her spellcasting speed is finished! She’s done..."
Rowenna stood completely still.
She slowly turned her head, looking down at her left shoulder.
She stared quietly at the tiny tear in her beautiful robe with the small insignificant scratch on her skin, and the single drop of crimson blood that had stained the fabric.
She blinked once then twice.
Then, Rowenna turned her gaze toward Frost. Her deep blue eyes did not contain anger.
They did not contain fear or panic either.
Instead, they contained a quiet terrifying sense of genuine amusement.
"You... actually managed to scratch me," Rowenna stated softly.
Her voice was light, musical, and completely unbothered by the frost supposedly invading her veins.

"That was quite clever, using your partner’s explosive backfire as a decoy," Rowenna praised him. "You caught me slightly off guard. I was carefully adjusting my spell parameters so I wouldn’t accidentally turn you both into a red smear on the dirt... and you used that fraction of a second well."
Frost’s triumphant laughter died instantly in his throat.
His eyes widened in sudden creeping horror as he looked at her pristine, unbothered face.
The frost wasn’t slowing her down at all.
"What... what are you talking about?!" Frost stammered, stepping backward.
Rowenna raised her left hand, gently resting her delicate fingers over the scratched shoulder.
’Well let me use my Genesis Rune that Lady Elu gave us...’
A brilliant, soothing emerald-green light erupted from her palm.
In a fraction of a second, the minor scratch closed itself, leaving no scar.
The freezing frost that had attempted to invade her bloodstream was completely purged from her system.
Even the torn fabric of her arcanist robe re-wove its own threads, repairing itself as if the attack had never even occurred.
Frost stumbled backward with his knees trembling violently beneath his armor.
"No... no way..." Frost muttered, his voice cracking with despair. "Instant cellular regeneration?! Without a chant or a holy priest?! That’s impossible!"
Rowenna gripped the Sapphire-Core World Weaver with both hands.
Her expression turned ice-cold and majestic as her full S-Rank aura flared to its absolute peak, shedding the last remnants of her restraint.
"Playtime is officially over, Wardens of the Unmovable Wall..." Rowenna announced calmly.
Her voice rang across the basin like a divine judgment, leaving no room for argument or hope.
"Let me show you what a true Grand Runemaster looks like."
Rowenna raised her staff with one hand, spinning it horizontally above her head in a rapid, sweeping arc.
’Gravitational Singularity Collapse!’
HUMMMMMMM.
The crushed forty-foot crater located directly behind Ignis and Frost suddenly burst into a blinding, incandescent purple glare.
The twenty-times gravity field didn’t just expand... it rapidly condensed.
The entire thirty-yard spatial zone collapsed inward upon itself, folding the fabric of space into a single microscopic black point hovering exactly three feet above the dirt between Ignis and Frost.
An irresistible, terrifying gravitational pull erupted from that microscopic black dot.
"NO! NO! RUN!" Ignis shrieked.
He tried to drive his fire into the ground to anchor himself, clawing desperately at the mud, but it was completely useless against spatial authority.
The gravitational singularity began pulling everything inward.
The surrounding air, shattered stone pillars, burning chunks of glaciers, boiling steam, and both Heroes were dragged violently toward the center!
"AAAAAHHHH!"
Ignis and Frost were dragged brutally across the dirt, screaming in sheer terror as their bodies were helplessly pulled into the collapsing point.
Their heavy metal armors slammed together with violent, bone-crushing force at the center of the singularity, trapping them in a crushed, immobile sphere of gravity.
Rowenna stood tall, raising her empty left hand into the air.
Her fingers came together in a clean, elegant snap.
"Collapse."
KA-BOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOM!
The microscopic gravitational singularity exploded outward in a colossal hundred-foot shockwave of pure spatial force.

The wave pulverized the surrounding terrain entirely. It tore through bedrock, obliterated the remaining ice, extinguished the fire, and blasted a massive pristine sixty-foot wide crater into the Umbral Basin!
The atmospheric shockwave generated by the blast sent a massive gust of wind rolling across the entire battle line, blowing away thick clouds of dust for half a mile in every direction.
The physical force of the spatial explosion completely shattered Ignis and Frost’s defensive core barriers.
The impact crushed their chest plates inward and shut down their neural systems instantly, protecting them from death but ensuring absolute incapacitation.
When the blinding purple light finally receded from the clearing, Ignis and Frost lay motionless in the center of the fresh crater.
Their armors were severely dented.
Their weapons were shattered pieces of scrap metal. They were completely knocked out cold and permanently neutralized from the battlefield.
Rowenna lowered her staff, twirling it once before smoothly sliding it back into her spatial storage rift.
The tear in space sealed shut behind her.
She lightly dusted off her pristine robes once more, letting out a long, quiet sigh as her long, silky hair settled perfectly across her back.
"That consumed slightly more mana than I initially calculated," Rowenna murmured softly to herself.
A sweet contented smile touched her lips as she looked back over her shoulder, gazing toward the distant rear command post where her Lord resided.
"I hope my Lord was watching..." she whispered affectionately.
Rowenna then turned her sharp gaze away from the crater, looking toward the far western flank of the battle line.
Across the torn mud, the main frontline collision was reaching its climax as the heavy combatants finally locked eyes.
Brida was advancing steadily across the open field.

Her massive frame was clad in heavy plate armor and she carried her colossal adamantine tower shield casually over her muscular shoulder with her heavy boot heels shattering the stone bedrock with every confident earth-shaking step.
Directly in her path stood Kassandra.
Kassandra was the heavy defender of the enemy forces... the Hero of the Unmovable Wall who commanded the Divine Aegis.
Kassandra stood incredibly firm in her pink-tinted tower armor.
Her long pink cape fluttered wildly in the dying thermal wind of the battlefield.
She held her massive kinetic redirection shield planted firmly into the earth with her entire body braced behind the metal.
The two defensive titans locked eyes across thirty yards of torn, bloody mud.
Brida stopped her steady march.
She threw her head back and let out a boisterous, booming laugh that echoed across the entire war zone.
"BAHAHAHAHA!" Brida roared into the sky.
She cracked her massive knuckles with the sound ringing out like snapping oak timber over the battlefield.

"Well, look at what we have here!" Brida mocked loudly, pointing a thick finger forward. "Shiny pink armor on a shiny big shield! Hey, pinky! Let’s see if that pretty toy of yours can hold up when a real woman puts her shoulder into it!"
Kassandra’s eyes narrowed dangerously behind her visor.
She lowered her center of gravity, planting her boots deeper into the mud.
Her core flared with brilliant, radiating pink defensive energy, illuminating the ground around her.
"Try your worst, Titan," Kassandra replied.
Her voice was firm, completely cold, and unyielding in the face of Brida’s towering presence.
"My Aegis absorbs and redirects all physical momentum," Kassandra warned her flatly. "You will only break your own bones against my wall."
"BAHAHA! I’d like to see it try!" Brida laughed wildly!
Without another word, Brida shot forward!
BOOM!

Kassandra’s eyes narrowed dangerously behind her visor.
She lowered her center of gravity, planting her boots deeper into the mud.
Her core flared with brilliant, radiating pink defensive energy, illuminating the ground around her.
"Try your worst, Titan," Kassandra replied.
Her voice was firm, completely cold, and unyielding in the face of Brida’s towering presence.
"My Aegis absorbs and redirects all physical momentum," Kassandra warned her flatly.
"You will only break your own bones against my wall."
"BAHAHA!
I’d like to see it try!" Brida laughed wildly!
Without another word, Brida shot forward!
BOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 320: Clash Of Titans [II]
paragraphs: Her frame broke into a full sprint with her heavy boots shattered the bedrock beneath her feet, leaving craters with every step.
BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!
Brida cocked her massive right fist backward, condensing hundreds of pounds of raw physical muscle, a lot of Vitality, and pure S-Rank momentum directly into her armored glove.
Kassandra didn’t retreat a single inch.
She slammed her pink shield deeper into the dirt, gripping the inner handles with both of her gauntlets as she surged her core output to its maximum limit.
Brida arrived in a flash of silver speed, driving her muscular fist straight into the center of Kassandra’s pink tower shield.
KRA-THOOOOOOOM!
A colossal shockwave of pure physical force detonated directly from the point of impact.
The atmospheric pressure blew away thirty yards of loose dirt in a perfect circle.
It pulverized nearby stone pillars into dust and sent massive clouds of debris soaring into the sky.
However, Brida’s strike did not break through.
The colossal kinetic impact hit the glowing pink barrier and completely stalled.
The entire force of the S-Rank punch was distributed evenly across the glowing runic surface of the shield, completely unable to reach Kassandra’s body.
Behind the glowing pink barrier, Kassandra’s eyes flashed with intense radiant pink light.
A sharp victorious smirk touched her lips as she easily held her ground against the Titan.
Kassandra clamped her gauntlets down tight on her shield with her voice echoing out clear and absolute across the battlefield.
"Shield World!"
...There was silence at first.
And then, there was light.
The pink runic lines etched into the heavy metal of the Divine Aegis flared with blinding incandescent radiance.
In a mere fraction of a second, that absorbed energy was violently expelled outward.
It did not return as a destructive blast of force, but rather as an infinitely expanding spatial domain.
VWOOOOOOM!
A massive translucent dome of solid pink runic light erupted from the center of Kassandra’s shield.

The dome expanded at the speed of sound, sweeping across the torn, bloody mud, completely swallowing Brida, Kassandra, and thirty yards of the surrounding battlefield in a perfect impenetrable hemisphere.
The walls of the dome locked into place with a heavy, resonating hum that vibrated deeply through the crushed bedrock.
The sky above them was instantly tinted in a cold, unforgiving shade of radiant pink.
The ambient noise of the surrounding war zone was completely and utterly severed.
The roaring flames of the distant elemental clashes, the shattering of glaciers, and the screams of dying infantrymen simply ceased to exist.
Inside the Shield World, there was only the heavy breathing of two towering defensive titans, and the soft pulsing hum of defensive magic.
Kassandra stood at the exact center of her domain.
Her pink-tinted runic tower armor gleamed flawlessly under the artificial light of her own making.
Her long pink cape settled softly against the back of her greaves, completely undisturbed by any wind.
She did not look exhausted as her posture was entirely relaxed with her armored hands resting casually on the inner grips of her massive kinetic redirection shield.
She looked at the towering Vanguard Shieldmaiden standing before her with a gaze of unyielding authority.
"I warned you, Titan," Kassandra spoke.
Her voice echoed off the translucent pink walls of the domain, returning with a surreal overlapping resonance that made her sound like a descending deity.
It made Brida’s ears itch.

"Out there in the open world, you might have been able to overwhelm my footing with brute-force mass," Kassandra continued calmly. "You might have been able to crack the earth beneath me and force me to stagger. But in here?"
Kassandra slowly lifted her chin behind her visor.

"In here, the very concept of physical damage no longer applies to me," Kassandra declared proudly. "Every ounce of force you generate within this domain is instantly absorbed by the atmospheric magic circles and fed directly back into my armor. You cannot scratch me. You cannot move me. You have trapped yourself in a cage of your own making..."
Brida stood fifteen feet away.
Her frame cast a massive, dark shadow across the crushed bedrock.
Clad in her heavy plate armor, the S-Rank Grand Titan Bastion looked slowly around the pink glowing dome.
She examined the smooth, impenetrable walls of runic light.
She looked down at her own massive right fist, which was still radiating wisps of white steam from the sheer friction of her previous completely nullified punch.
She felt the dense earth mana circulating through her Unyielding Bedrock Body, begging to be unleashed.
Then, Brida threw her head back.
"BAHAHAHAHA!"
Brida’s wild, booming unhinged laugh ripped from her throat, completely shattering the quiet sacred serenity of the Shield World.
Her eyes burned with a ferocious lust for battle that bordered on madness.
She didn’t look like a warrior who had just been trapped in an inescapable spatial prison... She looked like a predator who had just been handed a brand new toy.

"Is that it?!" Brida roared, taking a heavy confident step forward that cracked the bedrock beneath her boots. "You built a shiny pink cage so you wouldn’t have to feel the sting of a real woman’s fist?!"
BANG.
Brida slammed her own massive, adamantine tower shield into the bedrock with a deafening crash, completely ignoring Kassandra’s warnings about feedback.
"You think a little spatial trick is going to stop me from breaking your bones?!" Brida bellowed.
She reached over her broad, muscular shoulder.
Her thick, heavy leather gloves clamped down securely around the long, wrapped hilt of her weapon.
SHRRRRRRING.
With a terrifying screech of steel scraping against a heavy leather scabbard, Brida pulled out the Astral-Forged Void Cleaver.
The heavy battleaxe was an absolute monstrosity forged of Tier 3 mythril and abyssal iron.
Its massive broad cutting edge radiated a heavy suffocating aura of earth mana and uncompromising physical weight.
Just holding it caused the air around Brida’s arm to distort from the density of the weapon.
"Let’s see just how much physical momentum this little pink bubble of yours can actually swallow before it pops!" Brida screamed with joy.
Brida didn’t hesitate for even a fraction of a second.
She flooded her boots with massive amounts of physical momentum, actively engaging her Aegis Charge.
KABAAAAAAM!
Her massive frame surged forward like a runaway locomotive.
The physical force of her acceleration tore the bedrock beneath her boots into flying shrapnel.
She lowered her left shoulder securely behind her adamantine tower shield, holding the massive Void Cleaver high in her right hand, turning her entire body into a living battering ram.
Kassandra’s eyes narrowed dangerously behind her visor.
Whenever she used her domain, her opponents were usually quick to give up especially seeing the way their attacks had been dispelled but... What was wrong with this woman?

Did she have a complete brain? Why was she charging forward? No the main question was how was she charging forward like that... How the hell did she manage to build such momentum in a limited amount of time?
However...
Kassandra did not retreat a single inch.
She planted her boots firmly into the domain floor, lowering her center of gravity, and raised the Divine Aegis to meet the incoming Titan.
"Come!"
Brida slammed into Kassandra with a force greater than what she could usually handle.
KRA-THOOOOOOM!
The physical impact was apocalyptic as a massive shockwave of displaced air exploded outward from the collision, rippling violently against the inner pink walls of the domain.
However, exactly as Kassandra had promised, the Shield World instantly engaged its defensive mandate.
The second Brida’s adamantine shield crushed against Kassandra’s pink tower shield, the glowing magic circles along the dome’s walls flashed with blinding brilliance.
The kinetic energy generated by Brida’s S-Rank charge simply vanished.
It was absorbed instantly by the pink shield and funneled into the domain, leaving Kassandra completely unmoved with her boots not skidding a single millimeter backward in the dirt.
"I told you," Kassandra stated coldly, her voice echoing perfectly over the ringing sound of the impact. "It is useless."
Using the absorbed momentum, Kassandra immediately executed a brutal efficient counter-attack.
She pushed forward heavily with her shield, forcefully expelling Brida’s own charging energy straight back into the Titan’s chest.
BZZZZZZT!
A massive invisible pulse of pure kinetic force slammed directly into Brida’s breastplate.
The impact was heavy enough to instantly shatter the spine of any normal high-tier heavy infantryman.
It hit Brida dead in the center of her silver plate armor with a deafening ringing sound, carrying the exact same force that Brida had just delivered.
But Brida was not a normal heavy infantryman.
She was the S-Rank Grand Titan Bastion.

She possessed a high five-thousand points in her Vitality stat, and her passive trait, the Unyielding Bedrock Body, granted her total immunity to stagger, physical knockback, and displacement effects from anyone below her own monstrous rank.
Brida took the massive kinetic blast directly to the chest, and she didn’t even blink.
Her massive frame absorbed the shockwave as if a gentle summer breeze had brushed against her armor and she didn’t take a single step back.
"My turn!" Brida roared with a wild, feral grin.
While Kassandra was still recovering her posture from her own shield thrust, Brida pivoted sharply on her right heel.
She swung the colossal Astral-Forged Void Cleaver in a massive, horizontal arc aimed directly for Kassandra’s armored neck!
VWOOOOOOSH!
The heavy battleaxe tore through the air, shrieking like a falling artillery shell, fueled by raw earth mana.
Kassandra’s eyes widened slightly in shock at Brida’s lack of knockback, but her defensive instincts were elite.
She instantly dropped her center of gravity, bringing the thick edge of her pink shield up just in time to intercept the massive axe blade.
CLANGGGGGGG!
The mythril edge of the Void Cleaver slammed into the pink runic shield with a terrifying metallic shriek.
Bright orange and pink sparks showered violently across the interior of the domain.
Once again, the kinetic energy of the swing was completely absorbed by the Shield World.
Kassandra didn’t even feel the weight of the blow behind her shield.
The force was simply eaten by the domain walls, causing the pink light to glow slightly brighter.
"You are just wasting your stamina, Titan!" Kassandra yelled.
She thrust her shield forward again, attempting to bash Brida brutally in the face to create some distance.
Brida easily dodged the shield bash by rolling her thick muscular neck to the side.
She retaliated instantly with a brutal, heavy front kick aimed directly at Kassandra’s knee joint.
THUD!
The kick was instantly absorbed by a pink magic circle that flared into existence over Kassandra’s leg armor, nullifying the bone-breaking force completely.
The two towering defensive juggernauts engaged in a brutal, high-speed melee clash inside the absolute center of the pink dome.
It was an impossible battle of extremes.

Brida represented the unstoppable physical force... a woman whose muscle density and raw Vitality allowed her to swing a multi-ton battleaxe with the speed of a lightweight longsword, never tiring, never slowing down, and never flinching from incoming damage.
Kassandra represented the immovable object.

Her Shield World ensured that no matter how hard Brida swung, no matter how much dense earth mana she pumped into her Void Cleaver, the kinetic energy was simply swallowed by the domain and rendered entirely harmless.
Brida swung the battleaxe in a brutal overhead chop.
WHAM!
Kassandra blocked it effortlessly, the domain walls flaring bright pink to absorb the downward force.
Brida followed up instantly with a massive backhand swing of her adamantine tower shield.
CRASH!
Kassandra caught the edge of the adamantine shield with her own Aegis, entirely nullifying the lateral impact.
Kassandra pushed back aggressively, firing another concentrated blast of stored kinetic energy directly into Brida’s face.
BANG!
Brida simply smiled entirely through the blast.
Her Unyielding Bedrock Body absorbed the kinetic shock without allowing her head to snap back even a single inch.
Her thick neck muscles didn’t even strain.
"Is this really all you can do in your little pink cage?!" Brida laughed mockingly.
Her eyes were wild with exhilaration as she continued her relentless unending assault, treating the Hero like a heavy training dummy.
"You can’t hurt me!" Brida taunted, bringing her axe down again. "And all you’re doing is standing there taking my hits! This is just target practice! Come on, Pinky! Hit me back!"
Kassandra gritted her teeth behind her visor with her patience beginning to wear extremely thin.

chapters.title: Chapter 321: An Indestructible Domain? Jump Her!
paragraphs: She was a Hero of the Unmovable Wall.
She had stood against entire hordes of demonic beasts, high-tier mages, and towering siege engines.
But she had never, in all her years of combat under Sky’s banner, faced an opponent who simply ignored the fundamental laws of feedback.
Brida was willingly taking enough redirected blunt-force trauma to turn a normal human’s internal organs into liquid paste.
Yet, the Titan was just laughing enthusiastically and swinging harder with every single exchange.
"You arrogant mindless brute," Kassandra snarled.
Her voice dropped into a cold tone as she realized that simple redirection was not going to break this monster’s vitality.
"If simple kinetic redirection isn’t enough to crush your thick skull," Kassandra declared, "then I will simply use the entire domain against you!"
Kassandra slammed her tower shield violently into the dirt, channeling massive amounts of her mana directly into the crushed earth beneath her boots.
"Annihilate!" Kassandra commanded.
HUMMMMMMM.
The entire geometric structure of the translucent pink dome began to shift and hum with a terrifying high-frequency vibration.

The absorbed kinetic energy from Brida’s hundreds of heavy axe swings, shield bashes, and multi-ton foot stomps had been meticulously stored inside the walls of the domain over the last several minutes.
Now, Kassandra was preparing to detonate all of that stored physical force in a single concentrated inward blast.
The resulting atmospheric crush would turn the entire interior of the dome into a pressurized meat grinder.
Brida’s wild, enthusiastic grin finally faded into an incredibly dangerous smirk.
She gripped the long hilt of the Void Cleaver with both of her heavy leather gloves.
She planted her boots wide, drawing massive amounts of heavy, brown earth mana directly up from the crushed bedrock into her muscular arms, feeling the deep tectonic resonance of the Umbral Basin.
If Kassandra was going to try and crush her with the walls, Brida was going to shatter the entire floor to pieces.
"RAHHHHH!"
Brida roared at the top of her lungs, flooding her Void Cleaver with dense earth mana as she executed her Earth-Shattering Cleave.
Brida ripped the Void Cleaver through the air with terrifying velocity, bringing the massive battleaxe crashing straight down into the exact center of the pink runic domain.
CRRRRRRR-ACK!
The heavy mythril blade struck the bedrock with catastrophic force.

A thirty-meter line of hyper-compressed earth energy exploded forward from the impact point, tearing a massive, jagged fissure straight through the solid stone ground, aiming directly to swallow Kassandra’s boots.
However, before the catastrophic earth shockwave could reach Kassandra’s position, the pink floor of the Shield World flared with blinding brilliance.
The domain’s defensive rule engaged once more, treating the floor as an extension of Kassandra’s shield.

The massive thirty-meter line of earth-shattering force was forcefully absorbed into the runic array of the floor, completely neutralizing the tectonic attack before it could destabilize Kassandra’s footing.
Kassandra let out a triumphant mocking laugh.
Her armored hands glowed with densely concentrated energy as she prepared to release the Annihilation spell from the vibrating pink walls.

"I told you, you ignorant brute!" Kassandra yelled, her eyes flashing with guaranteed victory. "Inside this world, you are absolutely nothing! You cannot break my shields! You cannot harm me! Now, be crushed by the weight of your own physical force!"
The pink walls of the domain began to glow with blinding, lethal intensity, ready to unleash a multidirectional blast that even Brida’s five-thousand Vitality might genuinely struggle to endure.
But Kassandra’s triumphant laughter was suddenly cut short.
HSSSSSSSSSSSS!
A strange unnatural sound echoed through the serene, isolated silence of the Shield World.
It was a soft sickening hissing noise, sounding exactly like boiling acid violently melting through thick iron plating.
Kassandra frowned behind her visor.
Her glowing hands faltered for a fraction of a second with the Annihilation spell pausing its countdown.
She turned her head, looking over her pink armored shoulder toward the eastern wall of the translucent dome.
Directly in the center of the supposedly impenetrable pink runic wall, a small pitch-black anomaly had abruptly appeared.
It wasn’t a crack... It wasn’t a shatter point caused by brute physical force either since the domain was explicitly immune to physical damage.
Instead, it looked like a deep suffocating stain of pure void darkness was actively rotting away the runic fabric of the shield.
The dark void-bleed spread rapidly, eating through the complex geometric lines of Kassandra’s defense with horrifying conceptual ease.
The pink light flickered violently, sputtered, and permanently died around the spreading black stain.
"What... what is that?" Kassandra whispered.
Her core trembled with a sudden instinctual dread. She took a slow step backward.
"Physical attacks cannot breach the domain..." Kassandra muttered to herself in sheer disbelief. "Magical artillery cannot pierce the outer hull... what is eating through my barrier?!"
SHRRRR-IP!
The hissing sound grew louder, culminating in a sharp, horrifying tearing noise, as if the very fabric of space was being violently ripped open by a jagged rusty blade.
A tall sleek figure stepped directly through the rotting black hole in the domain wall.
Tasmin.
The S-Rank Shadow Commander walked casually into the isolated pink arena.
Her dark coat fluttered lightly as she stepped smoothly onto the crushed bedrock, completely unbothered by the heavy atmosphere.
Her piercing eyes swept across the interior of the Shield World.
She analytically noted the massive kinetic buildup humming in the walls and the heavy, paused standoff between Brida and Kassandra.
Tasmin held her twin chained shortswords loosely in her palms.
The dark mythril blades were dripping with a thick viscous aura of shadow and void mana.

It was the lingering lethal effect of her True Severing Edge passive trait—an armor-piercing property that allowed her blades to bypass fifty percent of any physical or magical armor hardness, applying a lingering void-bleed that simply rotted defensive magic away.
It had allowed her to effortlessly carve a doorway straight through the domain’s hardness.
Tasmin didn’t even look at Kassandra.
She tilted her head, locking her cold eyes entirely on the towering form of Brida.
"You are taking far too long, Meathead," Tasmin stated flatly.
Her voice dripped with dryness.

"I already finished scouting the eastern tree line, assassinated three of their heavy artillery commanders, and reported back to the rear," Tasmin listed off casually, twirling one of her shortswords. "And you are still in here playing rock-paper-scissors with the pink turtle."
Brida lowered her heavy battleaxe, resting the flat of the blade against the dirt.
She wiped a bead of sweat from her forehead as she offered Tasmin a broad unapologetic grin.

"Hey, don’t rush me, Shadow!" Brida yelled back cheerfully, her booming voice echoing in the enclosed space. "I was just about to test how much of my own kinetic force my bedrock body could absorb! This pinky was about to give me a free full-body massage!"
Tasmin let out a long heavy sigh.
She shook her head in sheer exasperation as the dark Eclipse-Thread chains rattled softly against her leather vambraces.

"Your brain is entirely composed of solid rock, Brida," Tasmin muttered under her breath, though a faint, highly amused smirk touched her dark lips. "If you let her detonate that kinetic spell, the collateral shockwave would have ruptured the ground beneath my newly secured supply lines. I cannot allow you to be an idiot while I am actively trying to work."
Kassandra stood entirely frozen in the center of her domain with her glowing pink eyes darting wildly between the towering Titan Bastion and the newly arrived Shadow Commander.
Her defense had been breached.
The perfect, isolated arena where she reigned supreme, where physical laws bowed to her will, had just been casually invaded by a woman who walked through solid light as if it were a beaded curtain.
A deep burning sense of outrage and indignation flared inside Kassandra’s chest.
"You... you infiltrated a sacred duel!" Kassandra shrieked.
Her pink runic armor flared with sudden defensive panic as she pointed a trembling gauntlet directly at Tasmin.

"This was a designated battle between heavy defenders!" Kassandra yelled, her voice cracking with fury. "Do you have no honor?! Do you have no shame?! Stepping into another Hero’s domain just to double-team them like street thugs?!"
Tasmin stopped twirling her blade.
She turned her head slowly. Her cold eyes locked flawlessly onto Kassandra’s pink visor.
The amused smirk on Tasmin’s face vanished instantly, replaced by the chilling, pragmatic apathy of a predator looking at a loud annoying piece of prey.
Tasmin let out a sharp mocking scoff.
"Honor?" Tasmin repeated. Her voice was laced with heavy, cynical venom. "Shame?"
Tasmin took a slow measured step forward.
The heavy Eclipse-Thread chains rattled softly against her dark leather vambraces.
CLINK!

"When I first dropped into this clearing," Tasmin explained coldly with her eyes completely dead. "I was immediately jumped by six of your heavy guards, ambushed by a hidden trap in the dirt, and completely surrounded by infantrymen trying to spear me in the back while I was trying to locate my primary targets."
Tasmin raised her twin shortswords, crossing them slowly in front of her chest as her shadow mana erupted around her boots in a swirling vortex of pitch-black darkness.

"There is no such thing as free fighting on this battlefield, Pink Turtle," Tasmin declared with lethality. "You are fighting the Vanguard of the Blessed Land. We don’t care about your honor. We only care about putting you in the dirt..."
Brida laughed wildly, slamming her Void Cleaver against her adamantine shield to create a deafening metallic roar.
CLANGGG.
"You heard the lady!" Brida bellowed happily. "No more playing nice! Let’s crack this shell!"
Kassandra panicked completely.
She immediately attempted to trigger the kinetic detonation of her Shield World walls before the two S-Rank monsters could overwhelm her.
"KINETIC ANNIHILATI—" Kassandra screamed, trying to force the domain to collapse inward but the dual assault of the Vanguard was already moving with terrifying, flawless synergy.
Brida completely abandoned all restraint.
She actively engaged her Full Counter skill, surging amounts of earth mana directly into her adamantine tower shield, bypassing the need for incoming attacks to charge it.
Instead of swinging her axe, Brida threw her entire multi-ton body forward, executing a point-blank shield bash aimed directly at the ground beneath Kassandra’s feet.
KABAAAAAAM!
The massive impact struck the floor of the domain.
Instead of allowing the Shield World to absorb the kinetic energy, Brida’s Full Counter forcibly reversed the flow, detonating her own stored impact force outward in a massive concussive shockwave.
"Gahhhh!"
The shockwave ripped upward through the floor, violently disrupting the delicate spell Kassandra was trying to activate.
The pink walls of the domain flickered and sparked wildly with the kinetic detonation failing to trigger!
"NO!" Kassandra cried out, stumbling backward as her footing was completely shattered by the earthquake.
That single fraction of a second of lost balance was all Tasmin needed.
Tasmin engaged her Phantom Leap, accelerating her neural reflexes to supersonic speeds.
SWISH!
She completely vanished from her physical position, leaving behind a fading residual shadow illusion that Kassandra reflexively tried to block with her massive shield.
Tasmin reappeared instantly in the blind spot directly behind Kassandra’s pink armored shoulder.
"Got you," Tasmin whispered softly, directly into Kassandra’s ear.
Tasmin didn’t strike the impenetrable armor with her shortswords.
Instead, she whipped her wrists violently outward, initiating her Voltaic Chain Execution.
SHK-SHK-SHK!
The dark Eclipse-Thread chains attached to the pommels of her blades shot forward like serpentine vipers.
The heavy, mythril-laced chains completely bypassed the flat defensive surface of Kassandra’s massive Aegis shield.
They whipped rapidly around Kassandra’s armored wrists, coiled tightly around her elbows, and finally wrapped securely around her neck.
"GHK—!" Kassandra choked, her pink eyes widening in terror as the cold chains locked her limbs entirely in place!
Tasmin ruthlessly channeled high-voltage super-heated crimson shadow-flames directly through the metal links.
FWOOOOOOSH.
The intense burning void-bleed magic didn’t need to break the physical hardness of the Shield World armor.

The dark flames simply seeped directly into the microscopic joints and seams of Kassandra’s greaves and gauntlets, burning her skin from the inside and completely paralyzing her nervous system with high-voltage electricity.
’Heheh...’
"AHHHHHHHH!"
Kassandra screamed in agony with her grip on her massive tower shield failing completely.
The heavy pink shield slipped from her paralyzed fingers, crashing heavily into the dirt.
CLATTER!
Without her active connection to the shield, the translucent pink walls of the Shield World began to rapidly dissolve into falling sparks of fading useless light.

HSSSSSSSSSSSS!
A strange unnatural sound echoed through the serene, isolated silence of the Shield World.

She turned her head, looking over her pink armored shoulder toward the eastern wall of the translucent dome.

It wasn’t a crack...

Instead, it looked like a deep suffocating stain of pure void darkness was actively rotting away the runic fabric of the shield.

Her core trembled with a sudden instinctual dread.
